name: CCS Signage Workflow
user_description: Streamline your sign shop's operations with ClayFlow Signage Suite. This intuitive, claymorphic interface visualizes your entire workflow from permitting to installation. Effortlessly manage work orders, track progress, assign tasks, and monitor timelines with drag-and-drop priority, detailed notes, and a visual Gantt chart. Boost team communication and project efficiency.

__do_not_create__.name: __do_not_create__
__do_not_create__.description: Inert accidental empty schema retained only because no exact schema-delete action is exposed by the current Base44 connector. Do not use.

Invoice.name: Invoice
Invoice.description: Canonical accounts-receivable invoice. Money fields are computed server-side by invoicingAction — clients never write totals directly. Links upstream by customer_id plus optional opportunity_id / estimate_id / work_order_id so one job's financials can be traced end to end.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one invoice create.

invoice_number.description: Human-facing invoice number (e.g. INV-1042). Generated server-side when omitted.

billing_type.description: Progress-billing classification. deposit/progress/final are produced by create_from_estimate; standard is a free-standing invoice.

customer_display_name.description: Frozen customer name at issue time for display and audit.

estimate_id.description: AllInOneEstimate the invoice was generated from, when applicable.

contact_id.description: CustomerContact the invoice is addressed to, when resolved.

location_id.description: CustomerLocation (job site) the invoice covers, when resolved.

line_items.description: Billing lines; server recomputes extended totals.

tax_rate.description: Decimal rate (0.0825 = 8.25%). Applied to taxable lines less discount.

deposit_applied.description: Customer deposit credited against this invoice.

credit_applied.description: In-store credit applied against this invoice (G-09); maintained server-side by the credit application.

pay_url.description: Online payment link for this invoice (Stripe-integration-ready placeholder — populated when a payment provider is wired).

amount_paid.description: Sum of recorded (non-void) Payments; maintained server-side only.

terms.description: Payment terms label (e.g. Net 30, Due on receipt).

notes.description: Customer-facing notes printed on the invoice.

source_summary.description: Provenance: which record generated this invoice and under what review.

fee_lines.description: Canonical OrderFee lines (shipping, postage, discount, misc fee) carried through order-to-invoice. Each line: {label, kind, amount, taxable, income_account_code}. Mirrored identically on AllInOneEstimate and Invoice.

label.description: Display label for the fee line.

taxable.description: Whether this line is included in the taxable base.

income_account_code.description: GL income account code for accounting export.

salesperson.description: Screen name of the salesperson credited for this invoice — carried down the chain from Opportunity/AllInOneEstimate.salesperson (CoreBridge 'Salesperson').

entered_by.description: Display name of the staff member who entered the originating order (CoreBridge 'Entered By'; from AllInOneEstimate.entered_by_display, falling back to the acting user).

income_account_splits.description: GL income split computed from line parts: one entry per distinct income account code with its summed amount. Used by accounting export and statement reporting.

income_account_code.description: GL income account code this split posts to.

amount.description: Signed amount posted to this account code.

statement_batch_id.description: Statement batch this invoice was included in, when customer statements are generated in bulk.

statement_period_start.description: Statement period start (YYYY-MM-DD) covered by the batch stamp (I-11).

statement_period_end.description: Statement period end (YYYY-MM-DD) covered by the batch stamp (I-11).

statement_generated_at.description: When the statement batch stamped this invoice (I-11).

splits_override.description: Manual GL-split override flag (I-02): when true, income_account_splits was hand-entered rather than auto-computed from line parts.

splits_override_by.description: Staff user/email who applied the manual split override.

splits_override_at.description: When the manual split override was applied.

splits_override_reason.description: Required reason recorded for the manual split override (audit trail).

name.description: Template name

product_type.description: Product type this template applies to

custom_dropdown_key.description: Key to lookup custom dropdown options

sub_items.description: Sub-items that appear when this item is selected

is_standard.description: Whether this is a standard template

FleetMigrationAudit.name: FleetMigrationAudit
FleetMigrationAudit.description: Admin-only dry-run, migration, and verification audit snapshots for the FleetMaster to CCS Fleet migration.

LaborServiceInventory.name: LaborServiceInventory
LaborServiceInventory.description: Catalog of outsourced services and labor line items. Each row's `service_category` drives a category-specific set of optional pricing/spec fields (defined in components/masterInventory/laborServiceCategorySchema.js). When service_category='concrete_service', the row carries the concrete supplier pricing matrix read by the Concrete | Masonry | Poles estimator.

name.description: Filter name

is_standard.description: Whether this is a standard (non-deletable) filter

owner_email.description: Sign-shop user email that owns newly created custom filters. Legacy rows may be blank.

selected_by.description: List of user emails who have selected this filter

FleetAlertSetting.name: FleetAlertSetting
FleetAlertSetting.description: CCS-local fleet alert rule. These rules are evaluated inside CCS Signage Workflow against Bouncie data — they do NOT change Bouncie's own notification configuration, which must be managed in the Bouncie app.

scope.description: 'global' applies to the whole fleet; 'vehicle' applies to vehicle_vin only and overrides the global rule.

threshold.description: Numeric threshold for rules that need one (mph, percent, minutes, miles, mpg, event count).

curfew_start_minutes.description: Curfew window start, minutes after midnight (curfew rule only).

curfew_end_minutes.description: Curfew window end, minutes after midnight (curfew rule only).

CustomerPortalLink.name: CustomerPortalLink
CustomerPortalLink.description: Bearer-token share link for the customer portal. The token itself is the capability — whoever holds it can read the linked record's sanitized view. Backend-only; created/revoked by staff through customerPortalAction.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one portal link.

token.description: Random bearer token embedded in the share URL.

customer_name.description: Customer name (can be linked to work order)

requestor_email.description: Email of the requestor (from user database)

date_needed_option.description: Optional text from the Smartsheet Date Needed column, such as ASAP or a scheduling note. Kept separate from ISO dates.

date_ordered_option.description: Optional text from the Smartsheet Date Ordered column, such as N/A, Stock or In Stock. Kept separate from ISO dates.

date_received.description: Date the order was received. ISO date only, never a text receipt option.

receipt_option.description: Optional text from the Smartsheet Date Received column, such as In Stock or a custom receipt choice. Kept separate from ISO dates.

status.description: Order status

smartsheet_sheet_id.description: Stable Smartsheet sheet identity for the linked mirror record. Never derived from row or column position.

smartsheet_row_id.description: Stable Smartsheet row identity for the linked mirror record. Used instead of visible row position, customer name, or sorting.

smartsheet_last_synced_at.description: Timestamp of the last fully verified Smartsheet synchronization for this Order.

smartsheet_sync_snapshot.description: Last successfully synchronized mapped values used for three-way Smartsheet/Base44 conflict detection.

smartsheet_pending_local_sync.description: Order Form-only durable marker that local Base44 edits are waiting for verified Save & Sync to Smartsheet. Cleared only after a confirmed Order push.

duplicate_review_status.description: Order Form-only review annotation for the possible-duplicate indicator. 'not_duplicate' means a human compared the group and confirmed the Orders are distinct; flagged groups with no value remain under review.

smartsheet_create_attempt.description: Order Form-only write-ahead marker for Smartsheet row creation. Stores the intended mapped snapshot before POST and, when returned, the permanent row ID before final link completion. Preserve unresolved attempts; never infer identity from values or retry an ambiguous POST.

automation_deadline_fired.description: Durable deadline-automation claim markers. Keys are ruleId|triggerType|dateNeeded, values are the ISO date the rule last fired for that combination, so daily reminder runs never re-fire the same rule for the same deadline.

SignageFactIndex.name: SignageFactIndex
SignageFactIndex.description: Keyword index for the signage ask-box — one row per (jurisdiction, term, fact) so in-app search is an instant indexed read instead of a scan. Terms come from fact keys, sign types, and significant evidence-quote words.

jurisdiction_id.description: JurisdictionProfile id the fact belongs to.

fact_id.description: SignageFact id this term resolves to.

weight.description: Relevance weight — fact-key terms rank higher than quote words.

name.description: Template name

Machine.name: Machine
Machine.description: Unified production machine registry for the estimator: one row per piece of equipment (roll-fed printer/cutter, sheet-fed press, or other production hardware). Carries run-cost economics (cost_per_hour, setup cost/time, disposable consumables), named speed/quality profiles, labor and margin hooks. Generalizes the narrower MachineRate pricing rows and the vinyl-specific VinylMachine records — those registries stay authoritative for their own modules; Machine is the cross-module catalog new estimating code should reference.

name.description: Machine label, e.g. 'HP Latex 360', 'CNC Router Table A'.

machine_type.description: Feed/class of machine: 'roll_fed', 'sheet_fed', or 'other'. Stored as a free-form string so additional classes can be introduced without a schema migration.

cost_per_hour.description: Machine run cost in $ per runtime hour.

profiles.description: Named speed/quality profiles for this machine, e.g. draft / production / high_quality. Each entry: { name: string, speed_settings: object } where speed_settings holds machine-specific rate keys (sqft_per_hour, inches_per_second, pass_count, etc.).

name.description: Profile label, e.g. 'draft', 'production', 'high_quality'.

speed_settings.description: Machine-specific speed/quality parameters for this profile; key set is module-defined.

disposable_cost_per_unit.description: Consumable/disposable cost per produced unit (blades, bits, ink allowance, etc.).

setup_cost.description: Flat $ charged once per job for machine setup, in addition to any time-based setup billing.

setup_minutes.description: One-time setup minutes billed at the machine rate each time the machine is used.

labor_pct.description: Percent of machine run time that requires paid operator labor (0-100).

weighted_multiplier.description: Complexity/difficulty weighting applied to this machine's computed cost before margin.

margin_chart_id.description: Optional reference to the margin/markup chart record used to price this machine's output.

income_account.description: Income account code/name this machine's revenue posts to (links into the accounting chart, e.g. an IncomeAccount row).

status.description: Lifecycle status, e.g. 'active' or 'inactive'. Inactive machines are ignored by pricing.

description.description: Free-form notes about this machine (location, capabilities, constraints).

ProofShareLink.name: ProofShareLink
ProofShareLink.description: External proof-share links (E-09): an opaque-token row per shared proof, created by staff, resolved by a backend function (asServiceRole) so unauthenticated third parties can view the pinned proof version + disclaimer. Backend-only RLS — NEVER exposed through staffDataRead; the public proof-share page resolves tokens via a dedicated function. Revocation and 30-day-max expiry are enforced by proofShareLinkModel.canViewShareLink.

token.description: Opaque share token (ps_<hex>); prod callers mint with a CSPRNG — deterministic shareToken(seed) is for tests/dev.

product_id.description: WorkOrder.products[] row id the shared proof belongs to.

work_order_id.description: Parent WorkOrder id — join key for the pinned proof render.

proof_version.description: Version PINNED at link creation; a newer product proof_version renders the link 'superseded' not invalid.

disclaimer_text.description: Legal/review disclaimer rendered on the share page (settings.proof_share_disclaimer override).

created_by.description: Staff user/email who minted the link.

expires_at.description: now + ttl clamped to (0, 30d]; expired links reject.

status.description: Operational review/finalization state; does not itself export payroll

review_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when moved to review

review_started_by.description: Administrator that moved the period to review

reopened_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when a finalized period was reopened

reopen_reason.description: Required reason when reopening a finalized period

last_request_id.description: Idempotency key for the latest period action

finalized_summary.description: Current or most recently retired payroll snapshot summary

finalized_summary_history.description: History of retired payroll snapshots across reopen and re-finalize cycles

user_email.description: Employee email; one authoritative Time Clock state row per employee

last_action_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp of the last confirmed clock action

last_request_id.description: Client request id of the last confirmed or in-progress clock action

last_request_payload_hash.description: Canonical payload hash bound to the current or last clock action request id when that action carries employee-entered data

pending_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when an in-progress transition began

break_status.description: Authoritative break state while the employee is clocked in

last_break_request_id.description: Client request id of the last confirmed or in-progress break action

break_pending_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when an in-progress break transition began

work_pause_status.description: Authoritative work-pause state while the employee is clocked in

active_work_pause_id.description: Current or pending TimeClockWorkPause record id

last_work_pause_request_id.description: Client request id of the last confirmed or in-progress work-pause action

work_pause_pending_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when an in-progress work-pause transition began

labor_status.description: Authoritative Current Work transition lock used to serialize labor changes with punches, breaks, and Work Pause

last_labor_request_id.description: Client request id of the last confirmed or in-progress Current Work action

labor_pending_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp captured when an in-progress Current Work transition began

labor_pending_activity_type.description: Activity bound to an in-progress Current Work start/change request

labor_pending_work_order_id.description: WorkOrder id bound to an in-progress Current Work start/change request

time_off_create_status.description: Backend-only serialization state for employee Time Off request creation

time_off_create_request_id.description: Request id currently holding the employee Time Off create lock

time_off_create_claim_token.description: Opaque backend claim token for the current Time Off create lock

time_off_create_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when the current Time Off create lock was claimed

correction_create_status.description: Backend-only per-employee serialization gate shared by Clock In, correction creation, manager approval, and pay-period finalization

correction_create_request_id.description: Request id currently holding the shared employee mutation gate

correction_create_time_entry_id.description: Operation binding for the shared employee mutation gate (TimeEntry id or internal operation key)

correction_create_payload_hash.description: Canonical payload hash bound to the current shared employee mutation gate

correction_create_claim_token.description: Opaque backend claim token for the current shared employee mutation gate

correction_create_started_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when the current shared employee mutation gate was claimed

user_email.description: Email of the employee

clock_in_request_id.description: Idempotency request id for the confirmed clock-in

clock_out_request_id.description: Idempotency request id for the confirmed clock-out

payroll_hold.description: Contested-entry flag set by managers; blocks payroll inclusion until cleared

payroll_hold_reason.description: Why the entry is on hold

cost_code.description: GL/cost code for payroll job-costing (set by managers or inherited from the labor segment)

union_local.description: Union local identifier for certified-payroll jobs

certified_payroll.description: Entry belongs to a prevailing-wage/certified-payroll job

prevailing_wage_rate.description: Prevailing-wage hourly rate locked at punch time for certified jobs

clock_in_geo.description: Kiosk device geolocation captured at clock-in (lat/lng/accuracy in meters)

clock_out_geo.description: Kiosk device geolocation captured at clock-out

status.description: Current status

last_notes_request_id.description: Idempotency request id for the most recent authoritative notes update

last_notes_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint binding the most recent notes update request to its TimeEntry version and note text

last_notes_updated_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp of the most recent authoritative notes update

last_notes_updated_by.description: Signed-in employee email that performed the most recent authoritative notes update

archived_test_data.description: Pre-production Time Clock test record excluded from live timekeeping

archived_admin.description: Administrative archival flag; archived records remain preserved but are excluded from normal timekeeping

archived_by.description: Administrator email that archived this TimeEntry

last_corrected_at.description: Server timestamp of the latest administrator correction

last_corrected_by.description: Administrator email that made the latest correction

last_correction_reason.description: Required reason for the latest administrator correction

last_correction_request_id.description: Correction request record that most recently changed this TimeEntry

break_tracking_used.description: Whether this shift used authoritative tracked break records

tracked_unpaid_break_minutes.description: Completed tracked unpaid break minutes deducted from worked time

work_pause_tracking_used.description: Whether this shift used authoritative Work Pause records

tracked_work_pause_minutes.description: Completed Work Pause minutes excluded from actual worked time

approval_status.description: Manager review state for this completed shift; does not itself mean payroll-finalized

approved_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp of the latest approval

approved_by.description: Administrator email that approved this completed shift

approval_note.description: Optional manager note stored with approval

approval_request_id.description: Idempotency key for the latest manager approval action

correction_needs_review_request_id.description: Employee correction submission request that most recently returned an approved shift to Needs Review

correction_needs_review_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp of the latest correction-triggered Needs Review transition

pay_period_id.description: Finalized TimeClockPayPeriod that locked this TimeEntry

pay_period_locked_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when this TimeEntry was locked by pay-period finalization

pay_period_locked_by.description: Administrator that finalized the pay period containing this TimeEntry

punch_exception_id.description: Open or most recent TimeClockPunchException associated with this shift

missed_clock_in_reported_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when an employee reported a missing Clock In and supplied the reconstructed start

missed_shift_reported_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when an employee reported an entirely missed shift and supplied attested start/end times

punch_resolution_pending_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when an old active shift was detached for missed-punch manager review

stale_shift_acknowledged_at.description: Trusted backend time when the employee affirmed they were still continuously working

stale_shift_acknowledged_request_id.description: Idempotency request id for the latest worked-through acknowledgement

work_day_group_id.description: Shared group id when this completed shift is confirmed as part of a multi-segment work day

work_day_anchor_date.description: Company date (YYYY-MM-DD) all grouped segments count toward for Time Tracker day totals

work_day_confirmed_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp of the same-work-day confirmation

work_day_confirmed_by.description: Actor email that confirmed the work-day grouping

work_day_declined_signature.description: Cluster signature declined for work-day grouping; suppresses re-prompting the identical cluster

FleetReservation.name: FleetReservation
FleetReservation.description: Fleet equipment reservation/assignment record for shared vehicles and non-road assets.

work_order_id.description: ID of the related work order

work_order_title.description: Title of the work order for display

performed_by_email.description: Email of user who performed the action

performed_by_name.description: Name of user who performed the action

doc_number.description: EST or INV document number from Corebridge

doc_type.description: Type of Pending Import: Corebridge estimate/invoice or detected duplicate

extracted_data.description: Full AI-extracted data from the PDF

match_candidates.description: Existing work orders that may be a match
