merged_into_id.description: Work order ID this was merged into

VinylInventory.name: VinylInventory
VinylInventory.description: Master catalog of vinyl rolls and sheets used across Channel & Dimensional Letters, Lobby Signs, Sign Maintenance, and the Vinyl Estimator. Captures everything an estimator needs: roll dimensions, costs, application/finish characteristics, expected life, layering rules, and per-estimator visibility. Multiple records can share a `product_group_key` to represent the SAME vinyl in different roll widths.

product_group_key.description: Optional stable key shared by inventory rows that represent the SAME vinyl product in different roll widths. Lets the estimator suggest the cheapest viable roll width for a given workflow.

MaintenanceActionRate.name: MaintenanceActionRate
MaintenanceActionRate.description: Per (sign-type × action) rate matrix. One row per combination. Drives the Service Items / Labor calculations.

rate_basis.description: How the time scales. per_letter scales by qty_letters, per_cabinet/flat is a one-shot per service item, per_unit scales by quantity (e.g. LEDs being replaced), per_sqft scales by cabinet face area.

base_minutes_flat.description: Used when rate_basis = 'flat' or 'per_unit' (then this is minutes per unit).

default_materials.description: Inventory items typically pulled for this (sign_type × action). Used to auto-fill the Materials picker.

SalesLocation.name: SalesLocation
SalesLocation.description: Point-of-sale location (till/drawer) for reconciliation batches and counter sales — the CoreBridge 'Location' registry. Admin-managed on the Reconciliation page. ReconcileWizard picks the batch location from active rows and stores the location name on the batch, so batches closed before this registry existed stay readable.

name.description: Display name of the location (e.g. 'Main', 'East counter').

code.description: Short uppercase code used on receipts and batch references (e.g. MAIN).

tax_group.description: TaxGroup group_name applied to sales rung up at this location.

active.description: Inactive locations stay on historical batches but are hidden from new selects.

name.description: Policy name (e.g., 'Standard Full-Time', 'Part-Time')

is_template.description: Whether this is a company template policy

time_off_types.description: Different types of time off in this policy

name.description: Type name (Vacation, Sick, etc.)

accrual_cap.description: Maximum hours that can be accrued (0 = unlimited)

carryover_max.description: Max hours that can carry over to next year (0 = none)

holidays.description: Company holidays included in this policy

floating_holidays_per_year.description: Number of floating holidays per year

FleetNotificationQueue.name: FleetNotificationQueue
FleetNotificationQueue.description: Durable Fleet email notification queue. Replaces browser timers; server worker sends/retries through CCS Gmail. Admin-readable and server-written.

notification_key.description: Deterministic idempotency key for one event/recipient notification.

MetalProject.name: MetalProject
MetalProject.description: Metal fabrication estimator project — items drawn from the Inventory catalog with fabrication, welding and finishing labor.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

builder_item_id.description: Stable hidden estimator row identity used only for Product/Part reconciliation. Existing rows are seeded from their legacy array index; new rows use generated IDs.

inventory_item_id.description: ID of the material from inventory

material_length_ft.description: Length of the inventory material used in feet

customer_pricing.description: Saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Preserves selected tier, category breakdown, volume discount and final customer price without changing internal Builder cost.

pricing_engine.description: F-23f: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge}. When present, metalPricingWire routes the sell side through the shared engine; absent = legacy pricing verbatim.

FleetFuelEntry.name: FleetFuelEntry
FleetFuelEntry.description: Fleet-specific fuel purchase/usage entry used for MPG and operating-cost analysis.

FleetLifecycleProfile.name: FleetLifecycleProfile
FleetLifecycleProfile.description: Fleet asset lifecycle and replacement planning profile. Fleet-only financial/strategic data.

GlobalPricingTier.name: GlobalPricingTier
GlobalPricingTier.description: Named shared pricing rule set applied across many catalog parts (CoreBridge 'Global Pricing Tiers' analog — e.g. 'Standard Tier', 'Painting', 'Retail Parts for Modifiers'). A part links to one of these rule sets instead of declaring its own chart; the rules list supplies the tier -> markup/market entries the pricing engine resolves for that part. Backend-only: all access goes through staffEntityWrite/admin functions.

name.description: Display label for this shared rule set, e.g. 'Standard Tier', 'Painting', 'Retail Parts for Modifiers'.

rules.description: Ordered rule entries resolving each customer tier to a markup percent or a market-based pricing mode.

tier.description: Customer tier this rule applies to — MarkupTier.tier_name, tier_number, or record id.

markup_pct.description: Markup percent over unit cost. 50 = sell at cost x 1.50. Ignored when market_based is true.

market_based.description: When true this rule participates in the market-based retail/discount chart rather than cost-plus markup.

description.description: Optional admin notes on the coverage or intent of this rule set.

status.description: Inactive rule sets are ignored by the pricing engine and hidden from part pickers.

FileBridgeUpload.name: FileBridgeUpload
FileBridgeUpload.description: PERMANENT append-only provenance ledger — every app-created/app-filed server file. NEVER reaped. rebuild_manifest on promotion sources from this ledger (FileIndex is hot-scope only and would lose cold-root provenance).

agent_id.description: Server that owns the file (primary at write time).

origin.description: Ledger rows are bridge-created by definition.

file_url.description: Staging copy in Base44 storage (source the agent pulls).

BuilderPriceRevision.name: BuilderPriceRevision
BuilderPriceRevision.description: Immutable audit revision created when a Builder Product is first frozen or when the user explicitly accepts an Update Price / reattachment / manual pricing action. Keeps before/after builder and price snapshots so historical pricing is never silently lost.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key used to make retryable Builder price acceptance create exactly one immutable audit revision.

changed_parts.description: Part-level old/new pricing and link changes included in this revision.

FileIndex.name: FileIndex
FileIndex.description: HOT-scope file metadata — customer-linked + usage-promoted folders only (~50k/agent cap, demote-oldest overflow). The authoritative full index lives in agent SQLite; this is the instant-search/browse tier. creation_request_key = path_key for idempotent upsert.

creation_request_key.description: = path_key (agent|root|nfc+casefold path).

customer_ids.description: Display hint; queries use root_key+parent_path prefix.

delivered_url.description: Full bytes in Base44 storage. Permanent once landed (no storage delete API) — keep_delivered_max_mb gates size.

emails_found.description: Number of matching emails found in Gmail

error_message.description: Top-level error message if the run failed

AccountDeletionRequest.name: AccountDeletionRequest
AccountDeletionRequest.description: Persistent user-requested account deletion review. Submission never deletes the user or related company data; processing is a separate admin action.

creation_key.description: Deterministic one-record-per-authorized-user identity for idempotent request submission

authorized_email_id.description: AuthorizedEmail record ID for the signed-in requester

user_email.description: Normalized email of the signed-in requester at submission time

user_name.description: Display name of the signed-in requester at submission time

status.description: Administrative processing state; submission only creates pending requests

requested_at.description: When the requester submitted the deletion review request

processed_at.description: When an administrator later resolved the request

processed_by.description: Administrator email that later resolved the request

resolution_source_updated_date.description: Pending record version used for the administrator's conditional resolution; supports safe duplicate retries.

CustomerContact.name: CustomerContact
CustomerContact.description: Canonical person/contact record belonging to a shared Customer. Owns contact-level roles and authority. Opportunity, EstimatingRequest, and future flows link here by contact_id once resolved. Never merge contacts by name alone.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one contact create.

display_name.description: Preferred display name; falls back to first+last when blank.

position.description: Job title/role at the customer (e.g. Owner, Facilities Manager).

authority_role.description: Contact-level authority for approvals, invoicing and site access.

is_primary.description: Primary point of contact for the account.

role.description: Contact role on the account — primary | billing | site (CoreBridge contact role). Complements the is_primary / is_billing_contact / is_site_contact flags and authority_role.

contact_roles.description: Canonical multi-role list from contactRolesModel.CONTACT_ROLES (primary | billing | jobsite | decision_maker | ap) — one contact can hold several roles that the single 'role' field cannot express.

roles_updated_at.description: Last time the contact's role assignments changed (G-04 audit).

roles_updated_by.description: Staff email that last changed the contact's role assignments (G-04 audit).

email_groups.description: Email distribution groups this contact belongs to (e.g. invoices, proofs, statements, marketing).

source_summary.description: Provenance: which record/import promoted this contact (e.g. Customer embedded contact fields, WorkOrder representative, OpportunityIntake capture).

contact_status.description: Contact lifecycle status — active | deactivated | do_not_mail | hot_prospect | referral (CoreBridge contact status).

device_name.description: Display name for the kiosk device (Front Lobby Kiosk, Shop Tablet 2)

device_key.description: Stable identifier stored in localStorage on the kiosk (kiosk_device_id)

location.description: Physical placement - Front entrance, Shop floor, Warehouse

last_seen_at.description: Updated whenever the kiosk registers or punches

firmware_version.description: Reported app/agent version for offline-update tracking

CustomerFolderLink.name: CustomerFolderLink
CustomerFolderLink.description: Canonical link between a Customer and their server folder. Confidence-scored; suggested links need human confirm, never auto-attach ambiguous. Broken links heal via reconcile.

auto.description: True if machine-matched (>=auto threshold + confirmed by rule).

broken_candidate.description: Fuzzy re-match suggestion when folder went missing.

SignHardwareInventory.name: SignHardwareInventory
SignHardwareInventory.description: Fasteners, anchors, standoffs, brackets, threaded rod, clips, screws, bolts, nuts, washers — anything mechanical that holds a sign together or attaches it to a structure.

PermitLookupIndex.name: PermitLookupIndex
PermitLookupIndex.description: Precomputed address-resolution index. One row per normalized address holds the resolver's jurisdiction pick, geohash cells for near-address reuse, and (later) the materialized office stack. Reads turn a lookup into one indexed entity fetch instead of a geocode chain plus 4-6 boundary queries. Rows are written by the resolver itself after a verified resolution, and by the validation/sweep workers as they process addresses.

address_key.description: Normalized full lookup key: lowercase, punctuation collapsed, unit designators stripped. Primary fast-path key — exact repeats of the same address in any casing hit this.

street_key.description: Normalized street part only (same normalization the rules use for address_key). Diagnostics and manual joins.

geohash5.description: 5-char geohash of the resolved pin (~5km cell) — county-level reuse.

geoid.description: Census/state GEOID of the pick when known.

pick_status.description: verified = location_verified resolution. rejected = invalid_input (deterministic not-an-address; cached to skip geocoding junk input). needs_review/unresolved are NEVER cached — they are not answers.

edge.description: Pin sat near a boundary when resolved. Edge rows are still served by exact address_key, but are never used for geohash-cell reuse for other addresses.

boundary_distance_m.description: Distance from the stored pin to the nearest relevant boundary at resolve time. Cell-reuse guarantee: a new pin may reuse this row only when its distance to the stored pin is strictly less than this value.

point.description: Resolved pin {lat,lng} for map display and cell-reuse distance checks.

geocode_snapshot.description: Minimal geocoder result needed to reconstruct the response (provider, formatted address, location_exact).

resolution.description: Resolver answer snapshot (status, target, targets, sources meta, reason). Boundary ring geometry is deliberately NOT stored — it is too large for an entity field.

office_refs.description: Materialized applicable-office stack (sign issuer, electrical issuer, inspection provider, zoning, overlays) — populated by the office-research pipeline once research completes.

lookup_revision.description: ADDRESS_LOOKUP_REVISION at write time — code changes invalidate rows.

ruleset_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the active PermitResolutionRule catalog at write time — a minted/changed rule invalidates rows.

resolved_at.description: ISO timestamp of the original resolution.

expires_at.description: Rows past this are treated as misses (30d verified, 90d rejected).

last_verified_at.description: Last time the pick was re-confirmed by a full resolution.

hit_count.description: Times this row served a lookup — feeds the index-utility dashboard metric.

office_refs_version.description: Hash of the office set materialized into office_refs — cheap staleness check when offices change.

parked_reason.description: Why the entry is parked instead of fully answered (e.g. 'needs_office_check' — jurisdiction resolved, offices still verifying).

zoning_district.description: Zoning district designation at this address when a municipal zoning GIS layer resolved it (e.g. 'C-2 General Commercial').

permit_required_hint.description: Quick permit-required signal scoped to this address (e.g. 'sign permit required — C-2' or 'exempt: temporary <32sqft'), when the jurisdiction's ordinance data supports it.

zoning_context.description: Full zoning-layer attributes at this address — district code, use category, height district, source service. Written by the local resolver when a verified municipal zoning layer (Columbus, Cleveland, …) answers the point query.

Project.name: Project
Project.description: Painting estimator project (paint / paint mask / supplies / labor).

hyperlink.description: Optional hyperlink related to the project

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first Painting Builder source create idempotent.

status.description: Project status

items.description: List of items in the project

edge_complexity_multiplier.description: Multiplier for complex shapes edge painting

paint_colors.description: List of paint color codes (e.g., PMS 186C)

paint_mask_sqft.description: Square feet of paint mask needed

paint_supplies_per_sqft.description: Paint supplies cost per square foot

total_liquid_paint_and_supplies_cost.description: Total liquid paint and supplies cost

customer_pricing.description: Optional saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Painting internal cost remains unchanged until a tier is explicitly applied.

pricing_engine.description: F-23g: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge}. When present, paintPricingWire routes the sell side through the shared engine; absent = legacy pricing verbatim. (Project is painting-dedicated — only PaintingEstimator consumes it.)

opportunity_id.description: Optional transitional link to the canonical Opportunity. Blank on legacy/unmigrated WorkOrders.

estimating_request_id.description: Optional link to the EstimatingRequest that produced or is associated with this WorkOrder. Blank is valid during compatibility migration.

estimate_id.description: Linked AllInOneEstimate id, when this job was created from an estimate.

estimate_ids.description: Every AllInOneEstimate id merged into this job. Populated by combined multi-estimate conversion; the primary estimate also remains in estimate_id for backward-compatible single-link lookups.

materials.description: Flattened materials manifest built at estimate conversion from the estimate's BuilderPart frozen-cost snapshots. Each row carries its full provenance (source_estimate_id, estimate_line_id, builder_product_id, module_key, section_name) so section-level pricing origin survives the merge onto the WorkOrder.

source.description: Origin marker — 'estimate_conversion' for rows seeded from a converted estimate.

image_url.description: URL of the work order image

attachment_refs.description: References to files/photos carried over from the linked estimate (no binary copies).

files.description: Uploaded files for this work order

google_drive_folder_url.description: Google Drive folder URL for this work order

google_drive_file_ids.description: Array of Google Drive file IDs

manual_stage_override.description: When true, product-driven stage derivation (B-13) does not move current_stage; set/cleared by manual stage UI

fulfillment_method.description: Order-level fulfillment method (A-28); product-level fulfillment_method may override per product

notes.description: Array of tasks with timestamps, completion status, and dependencies

sales_import_source_id.description: Stable external source row identity used by repeat Sales Pipeline spreadsheet imports.

sales_import_last_synced_at.description: Timestamp of the last successful Sales Pipeline spreadsheet sync for this WorkOrder.

sales_import_snapshot.description: Last imported values for spreadsheet-owned Sales fields, used to detect stale spreadsheet overwrites.

smartsheet_sheet_id.description: Stable Smartsheet sheet identity for the linked mirror record. Never derived from row or column position.

smartsheet_row_id.description: Stable Smartsheet row identity for the linked mirror record. Used instead of visible row position, customer name, or sorting.

smartsheet_parent_row_id.description: Stable parent-row identity from the Workflow Smartsheet hierarchy. Order Form uses this to suppress automatic child/rider rows without relying on row position or customer-name guessing.

smartsheet_last_synced_at.description: Timestamp of the last fully verified Smartsheet synchronization for this WorkOrder.

smartsheet_sync_snapshot.description: Last successfully synchronized mapped values used for three-way Smartsheet/Base44 conflict detection.

smartsheet_create_attempt.description: Sales-only durable Smartsheet row creation reservation. Stores a pre-POST mapped snapshot and, if confirmed, a permanent row ID for verified one-time recovery. Never auto-repeat an uncertain create or infer row identity from its values.

automation_deadline_fired.description: Durable deadline-automation claim markers. Keys are ruleId|triggerType|dueDate, values are the ISO date the rule last fired for that combination, so daily reminder runs never re-fire the same rule for the same deadline.

sales_neutral_closed_at.description: Explicit user-confirmed neutral Sales archive timestamp for Closed - Did not Lose. Never counted as Won or Lost; no legacy task inference.

estimate_revision_required.description: Set when the linked estimate's quote total diverges from the amount this Work Order was built on. Sticky until manually reviewed.

sales_quote_sent_verified_at.description: Timestamp proving the current date_estimate_sent was explicitly confirmed by a verified Base44 Sales/Estimator action. Blank means the stored date is legacy or otherwise unverified and must not drive quote-aging analytics.

install_route_order.description: Per-day install route stop ordering managed by the InstallRouteMap page.

sales_last_follow_up_completed_at.description: Timestamp of the latest completed Sales Pipeline follow-up. Each change is preserved in CellHistory.

sales_last_follow_up_outcome.description: Business-readable outcome of the latest completed Sales Pipeline follow-up. Each change is preserved in CellHistory.

expected_close_date.description: Expected sales close date for an open opportunity.

sales_last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of the latest verified sales-specific activity. Used for stale-opportunity reporting going forward.

sales_stage_changed_at.description: Timestamp of the latest verified Sales Pipeline status change.

lost_reason.description: Sales reason captured when an opportunity is marked Lost. Preserved in change history when reopened.

billing_schedule.description: Progress (milestone) billing schedule. Each row is a percentage of contract value; saved schedules are normalized so cumulative pct never exceeds 100.

deposit_required.description: When true, this job requires a deposit before production work begins. Product moves into production statuses prompt a deposit warning until deposit_invoiced is set.

deposit_amount.description: Deposit amount required on this order, in dollars.

deposit_invoiced.description: Deposit has been invoiced — maintained from the Job Workspace financials card with a compare-and-set write.

estimate_line_id.description: Source All-In-One estimate Product line id when this product was carried from the estimator.

builder_product_id.description: Linked BuilderProduct id. BuilderProduct/BuilderPart remain the authoritative production BOM/configuration.

source_estimate_id.description: AllInOneEstimate id this product row came from — set on every conversion row so combined multi-estimate jobs keep per-estimate section provenance.

source_estimate_number.description: Estimate number of the source estimate at conversion time (display aid alongside source_estimate_id).

quoted_unit_price.description: Accepted customer unit price at WorkOrder conversion; never internal Product cost.

quoted_total.description: Customer Product total after quantity and Product adjustment at WorkOrder conversion.

operational_status.description: CoreBridge-style WIP operational state for this product, independent of the work-order stage.

fulfillment_method.description: Per-product fulfillment method (A-28); falls back to order-level fulfillment_method

notes.description: Channel-scoped product notes (A-30/B-10): {id, channel, text, author, created_at}

responsibility_color.description: Display color for the responsibility department/person/group badge.

priority.description: CoreBridge-style 1-99 line priority; distinct from queue_priority ordering.

quick_tags.description: Persistent custom substatus tags applied to this product.

design_time_seconds.description: Accumulated design labor time logged against this product, in seconds.

production_time_seconds.description: Accumulated production labor time logged against this product, in seconds.

proof_file_url.description: URL of the current proof file version for this product.

proof_file_name.description: Display name of the current proof file.

proof_version.description: Current proof file version (1-based). 0 means no proof file.

proof_approved_version.description: Proof version the current approval applies to. 0 means no versioned approval; approvals do not carry to newer versions.

proof_sent_at.description: ISO timestamp when the current proof was sent to the customer (A-33); anchors H-06 proof follow-ups.

proof_submitted_at.description: ISO timestamp when the proof was submitted/uploaded for review (A-33).

proof_follow_up_state.description: Per-product follow-up machine snapshot (H-06): {stage, last_sent_at, next_due_at, ...}.

operational_status_changed_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last operational_status change on this product.

sip_checklist.description: SIP meeting checklist with product groupings and hierarchy

mmm_sip_checklist.description: Monday Morning Meeting checklist - completely separate from SIPs

mmm_checklist.description: Legacy Monday Morning Meeting checklist items

sip_completed.description: Whether this item has been completed/discussed in SIPs or MMM meeting

sip_revisit_date.description: Date to revisit this project in SIPs - jobs with a future date are separated from the active list

mmm_last_discussed_at.description: Timestamp of the last Monday Morning Meeting discussion mark. Rows move to the Discussed section for the current week (Mon-Sun) and return to the active list next Monday. Independent of sip_completed.

mmm_defer_until.description: Monday Morning Meeting snooze date - rows with a future date are parked in the Discussed & Scheduled section and return automatically when it passes

mmm_tasks.description: Monday Morning Meeting task list - MMM-only items shown inline under the board row until completed. Separate from the shared notes task list.

pending_permit_locality_id.description: Deferred office apply — PermitLocality id queued to auto-apply once its sign+zoning offices verify. Marker only; the queue itself lives on the locality's pending_applies.

pending_permit_locality_name.description: Display name of the locality queued for deferred apply (renders the pending chip in the permitting client group).

PermittingWorkflowDraft.name: PermittingWorkflowDraft
PermittingWorkflowDraft.description: Permitting-only review draft. Never a job, approved requirement or operational workflow. Immutable snapshot; regenerate to create a new version.

Report.name: Report
Report.description: Estimator bug report / feature request, with discussion thread. Surfaced on the estimator Report page.

type.description: Whether this is a bug report or feature request

description.description: Detailed description of the bug or feature

status.description: Current workflow status

category.description: Broad area of the app this report relates to

page_location.description: Where in the app the bug occurred or the feature should live

FleetPart.name: FleetPart
FleetPart.description: Fleet-specific parts inventory. Separate from all signage/master/estimator inventories. Category is intentionally open-text so historical FleetMaster values are preserved exactly.

alternate_part_numbers.description: Cross-reference, superseded, OEM, or alternate numbers used only for Fleet part lookup.

barcode_value.description: Optional UPC/EAN/barcode text from packaging or label.

category.description: Canonical or historical Fleet category. Historical values are preserved exactly during migration.

specification.description: Fitment/specification text such as dimensions, thread, amperage, filter type, belt size, etc.

source_urls.description: Reference/research URLs used to verify Fleet part identity. Never treated as authoritative by themselves.

compatibility_notes.description: Human-reviewed fitment/compatibility notes. Empty equipment list still means unrestricted unless notes say otherwise.

created_from_identification_id.description: FleetPartIdentification id that created this part, when applicable.

created_from_request_id.description: FleetPartFluidRequest id that created this inventory row, when applicable.

receive_receipt_key.description: Deterministic receive receipt key used to prevent duplicate inventory creation on retries.

creation_key.description: Stable client-generated idempotency key for a logical Fleet part create operation.

BuilderProduct.name: BuilderProduct
BuilderProduct.description: Persistent estimator Builder Product. A Builder Product is the internal/physical product record behind an All-In-One estimate line. It preserves the entire estimator/source-project snapshot, frozen pricing state, client-facing naming, and links to BuilderPart / BuilderPartGroup records. Quick Products remain a separate reusable product type.

estimate_id.description: Owning AllInOneEstimate id when this product belongs to an estimate.

estimate_line_id.description: Stable id stored on the owning AllInOneEstimate line item.

module_key.description: Current estimator module key, e.g. foundation, channel_letters, vinyl, cnc.

source_entity.description: Entity that owns the detailed estimator record, e.g. FoundationProject.

builder_name.description: Internal estimator-facing name/type. Visually distinct from client_product_name.

client_product_name.description: Editable client-facing product name shown on quotes.

product_category.description: User-defined Product Category used for estimate organization, filtering, quoting, Quick Products and clipboard metadata.

production_product_type.description: Optional production/SIP Product Type selected from GlobalSettings.productTypes. Blank means intentionally unclassified.

product_notes.description: Estimator-facing Product notes preserved by cloning, Quick Products and clipboard operations. Separate from the customer-facing description.

builder_snapshot.description: Complete lossless snapshot of the detailed estimator/source project used to build this product.

builder_snapshot_hash.description: Stable hash/fingerprint of builder_snapshot when available.

frozen_cost.description: Cost frozen when the builder product was last intentionally priced/updated.

frozen_customer_price.description: Compatibility/audit snapshot of the accepted UNIT Product base price before estimate-line customer_quantity and adjustment_percent are applied. The live quote is calculated from AllInOneEstimate.line_items, not from this field.

current_recalculated_cost.description: Most recently detected cost using current inventory. Does not replace frozen_cost until Update Price is accepted.

price_recalc_required.description: True when current Master Inventory pricing changed after the Builder was last calculated and this module cannot safely recompute the full Product total without reopening/saving the Builder. Update Price is blocked until recalculation.

price_recalc_reason.description: Human-readable reason Update Price is blocked pending Builder recalculation.

needs_reattach_review.description: True when one or more linked inventory parts were detached and the user must be offered reattach choices on edit.

legacy_bom_reconciled.description: True only for historical legacy_frozen Products whose active frozen BOM has been reconciled to the authoritative saved legacy Builder cost categories. While the Product remains legacy_frozen, normal estimate-open refresh preserves this historical BOM instead of re-extracting modern Builder detail from partially populated legacy fields.

legacy_bom_reconcile_version.description: Version/batch identifier of the historical BOM reconciliation logic.

operational_status.description: CoreBridge-style WIP operational state for this product, independent of the work-order stage.

operational_substatus.description: Free-text persistent quick-tag layered on operational_status (e.g. waiting-on reason).

customer_facing_status.description: Customer-safe display label mapped from operational_status; portals show this instead of internal states.

fulfillment_state.description: Built/completed fulfillment disposition for this product. Distinct from operational_status and from invoice payment state.

design_due_date.description: Design deadline for this product, computed from part lead times or manually set.

product_due_date.description: Production deadline for this product. The work-order due date derives from the latest product due date.

hard_due_date.description: When true, automated due-date recalculation (e.g. on proof approval) must not move this product past its current due date.

responsibility.description: Queue prioritization responsibility (department/person/group) used by production queues.

queue_priority.description: Numeric queue priority 1-99 within responsibility, mirroring CoreBridge queue prioritization.

proof_status.description: Customer proof approval state for this product; approval can trigger due-date recalculation.

proof_file_url.description: URL of the current proof file version mirrored from the WorkOrder product.

proof_file_name.description: Display name of the current proof file.

proof_version.description: Current proof file version (1-based). 0 means no proof file.

proof_approved_version.description: Proof version the current approval applies to. 0 means no versioned approval.

operational_status_changed_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last operational_status change on this product.

user_email.description: Employee email for this Time Clock badge

token_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the badge bearer secret; raw token is never stored

BuilderPart.name: BuilderPart
BuilderPart.description: A frozen-price part inside a Builder Product. Stores the live inventory link plus a complete inventory snapshot and builder/calculation snapshot from the moment the cost became active. Missing/detached inventory never destroys the frozen cost; reattachment is explicit.

part_key.description: Stable key within the product for ordering/copying/reconciliation.

part_type.description: Open string by design so additional legacy/master-inventory part types can be added without a schema migration.

source_template_id.description: PartTemplate record this independent copy was instantiated from. Blank for Builder-produced, manual, and clipboard Parts.

source_template_version.description: template_version of the source PartTemplate snapshot; 0 when the Part did not come from the Part Library.

source_path.description: Path inside the detailed builder snapshot that produced this part, e.g. items[0].materials[2].

builder_sync_state.description: Whether this Part continues to synchronize from its Builder. detached_override freezes a Builder-produced Part until reattachment; manual is a Custom Product Part; manual_addon is an independent Part intentionally added to a Builder Product and remains outside Builder reconciliation.

builder_detached_by.description: Display name or email of the user who detached this Part from its Builder. Cleared on reattach.

builder_detached_snapshot.description: Builder-produced Part state captured when an override was detached, used for audit and reattachment review.

inventory_entity.description: Master Inventory entity currently linked to this part.

inventory_item_id.description: Current linked inventory record id. May be blank while detached.

original_inventory_item_id.description: Inventory id used when the frozen snapshot was created; never overwritten during reattachment.

frozen_inventory_snapshot.description: Complete inventory row as it existed when this part's cost was frozen.

current_inventory_snapshot.description: Last current inventory row seen during price/detach checking. Does not alter frozen pricing by itself.

detail_overrides.description: Estimate-specific type/detail overrides layered over frozen_inventory_snapshot for this Part only. Never mutates the Master Inventory snapshot and is cleared when a detached Builder Part is reattached.

calculation_snapshot.description: Complete module-specific calculated outputs/breakdown for this part.

pricing_basis_snapshot.description: Pricing mode, rate fields, dimensions, units, and other data necessary to explain/reproduce the frozen cost.

inventory_updated_date_snapshot.description: Inventory updated_date at the moment the frozen price was accepted.

manual_cost_override_reason.description: User-entered reason recorded when a manual/detached Part cost was overridden.

income_account_code.description: GL income account code this part's sales post to on accounting export.

cogs_account_code.description: GL cost-of-goods-sold account code this part's material cost posts to on accounting export.

pricing_template_id.description: PricingTemplate record applied to this part's pricing.

design_lead_days.description: Lead-time days attributed to design work for this part.

product_lead_days.description: Lead-time days attributed to production for this part.

labor_level_id.description: Labor level/skill tier used to price this part's labor.

machine_ids.description: Machine records this part routes through in production.

taxable.description: Whether this part's charges are taxable.

separate_on_invoice.description: Whether this part is broken out as its own invoice line.

double_sided.description: Whether this part is produced double-sided.

min_charge.description: Minimum charge floor applied to this part.

parent_sizes.description: Parent sheet/stock size labels this part can be cut from.

vendor_id.description: Vendor record supplying this part or its primary material.

vendor_name.description: Display name of the supplying vendor (denormalized; catalog import lane already stores it).

vendor_cost.description: Vendor-quoted unit cost for this part — outranks vendor default_cost and generic cost in vendorCostModel retail resolution.

vendor_markup_percent.description: Retail markup percent applied to the resolved vendor cost for this part; outranks vendor defaults and generic markup_* fields.

vendor_markup_flat.description: Flat markup added after the percent markup for this part's vended retail.

is_vended.description: Explicit vended flag — one of the vendorCostModel vended-part signals (flag | vendor_id | vendor_name | vendor_cost).

mfg_part_number.description: Manufacturer/vendor part number used for ordering.

size_discounts.description: F-14: Volume/size discount threshold rows applied post-tier. Each row grants discount_pct off the tier-priced base when the part's measure on threshold_basis (sqft|width_in|height_in|area_sqin|perimeter_in) reaches threshold_value; the largest qualifying threshold wins (ties → highest pct). Resolution lives in base44/shared/sizeDiscounts.ts.

labor_levels.description: F-25: explicit LaborLevel assignments alongside labor_level_id — each entry may be a level id or {labor_level_id, rate_basis, hours, rate} row resolved by marginModel's labor cost chain.

machine_id.description: Primary machine this part routes through (singular companion to machine_ids; first-declared machine ref wins in marginModel).

machine_hours.description: F-25: per-machine run hours keyed by machine id (or a flat number for the primary machine) feeding marginModel's machine-time cost.

modifiers.description: F-25: PricingModifier attachment refs (ids or inline modifier rows) — canonical attachment field resolved before modifier_ids/pricing_modifier_ids aliases.

modifier_answers.description: F-25: collected modifier answers keyed by modifier id or name; drives option rate_overrides in modifier cost resolution.

area_sqft.description: Area in square feet (canonical alias of sqft) used by per-unit modifier rates and waste scaling.

waste_factor.description: Material waste multiplier (e.g. 1.1 = 10% waste) applied to waste-affecting cost components.

machine_cost.description: F-25: explicit machine-cost override for this part; when set it outranks the machine-rate resolution chain.

labor_cost.description: F-25: explicit labor-cost override; outranks labor-level resolution when present.

modifier_cost.description: F-25: explicit modifier-cost override; outranks the modifier attachment resolution when present.

material_cost.description: F-25: explicit material-cost override; outranks frozen/current cost snapshots when present.

cost_breakdown.description: F-25: free-form cost component bag ({material, machine, labor, modifier, ...}) — marginModel reads explicit totals from it after dedicated fields.

user_email.description: Email of the user these settings belong to

show_work_orders.description: Show work order due dates on calendar

show_personal.description: Show personal events created by this user

work_order_stages.description: Which stages of work orders to show (empty = all)

FleetMaintenanceWorkOrder.name: FleetMaintenanceWorkOrder
FleetMaintenanceWorkOrder.description: Fleet maintenance work order. Completely separate from customer/signage WorkOrder and never enters the signage production pipeline.

equipment_id.description: Linked FleetEquipment id when resolvable. Optional so historical orphan work orders can be preserved.

source_equipment_id.description: Original FleetMaster Equipment id, retained even if the relationship cannot be resolved.

source_part_id.description: Original FleetMaster Parts id or 'custom' value, retained even when no current inventory row exists.

source_fluid_id.description: Original FleetMaster Fluids id or 'custom' value, retained even when no current inventory row exists.

quantity_quarts.description: Historical FleetMaster field retained verbatim when present.

quantity.description: Normalized usage quantity for future CCS Fleet operations.

mechanic_operation_key.description: Durable receipt key for the most recently applied external mechanic start/progress mutation.

mechanic_operation_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 payload fingerprint bound to mechanic_operation_key so a request id cannot be reused with different mechanic data.

mechanic_operation_applied_at.description: Server timestamp for the most recently applied external mechanic mutation.

completion_receipt_key.description: Idempotency receipt for a completion operation.

generation_key.description: Deterministic scheduled-generation key preventing duplicate Fleet work orders.

public_submission_key.description: Anonymous public-report idempotency key. Used only by the tightly scoped Fleet public issue endpoint.

migration_source_created_by_id.description: Original FleetMaster creator user/service id retained for historical audit.

migration_source_created_by.description: Original FleetMaster creator email retained for historical audit.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.description: Canonical payment applied to an Invoice. Always written by invoicingAction so invoice balances stay consistent — never edited directly. Void/refund rather than delete to preserve the audit trail.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one payment record.

customer_id.description: Denormalized from the invoice for AR queries.

amount.description: Signed amount applied to the invoice: positive for payments, negative for credit-memo and refund rows. Invoice amount_paid is the net sum of recorded + refunded rows.

reference_number.description: Check number, card auth, ACH trace, or other external reference.

status.description: recorded = live row (payments positive, credit memos negative); refunded = a negative refund row or a fully-refunded original payment; void = reversed.

refund_of_payment_id.description: On refund rows: id of the original Payment this refund reverses.

refunded_amount.description: On original payments: cumulative refunded dollars so far (partial refunds allowed).

reconciliation_batch_id.description: ReconciliationBatch this payment was swept into at cash close. Empty = still unreconciled. Set only by manageReconciliation.

portal_source.description: Event-class marker on portal-originated payment rows, e.g. "added from Customer Portal". Empty = staff-entered.

portal_link_kind.description: CustomerPortalLink.kind that originated a portal payment.

portal_actor.description: Link label / contact name recorded as the portal-side actor.

recorded_via.description: 'portal' for portal-originated payments; empty for staff entry.

portal_recorded_at.description: ISO timestamp the portal payment was recorded.

estimating_request_id.description: Denormalized EstimatingRequest id for intake-chain reporting.

deposit_applied_to_invoice_id.description: On deposit rows: id of the Invoice this deposit was later applied to.

gl_memo.description: Free-text memo carried to GL/accounting exports.

name.description: Display name, e.g. 'Apprentice', 'Journeyman Installer', 'Lead Fabricator'.

level_rank.description: Seniority/skill rank used for sorting; higher levels typically bill at higher rates.

description.description: Optional notes about what work this level covers.

hourly_rate.description: Billable rate in $/hour for work performed at this level.

applies_to_categories.description: Optional list of category keys (MarkupCategory.category_key) this level applies to. Empty = usable on every category.

rate_basis.description: Throughput basis for labor computation: sqft_per_hour = area/rate hrs; units_per_hour = qty/rate hrs; hours_per_unit = qty*rate hrs; flat_hours = rate hrs.

rate_value.description: Throughput number for rate_basis (e.g. 125 for '125 sqft/hr').

status.description: Inactive levels are ignored by the pricing engine.

updated_by.description: Email of the staff user who last saved this row (audit).

CustomerLocation.name: CustomerLocation
CustomerLocation.description: Canonical reusable physical location/site belonging to a shared Customer. Owns site identity, addressing and jurisdiction hints. Opportunity, EstimatingRequest, Orders and future installation/permitting flows link here by location_id once resolved.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one location create.

label.description: Human label such as 'Main Office', 'Storefront', or the street address.

jurisdiction_profile_id.description: Resolved Permitting JurisdictionProfile id when known. Nullable until jurisdiction resolution runs; never fabricate.

jurisdiction_name.description: Display jurisdiction name captured with the resolution evidence.

property_owner_name.description: Property owner of record when different from the customer; permitting evidence.

access_notes.description: Gate codes, entry instructions, site contact details.

source_summary.description: Provenance: which record/import promoted this location (e.g. WorkOrder install_location, Customer billing address, OpportunityIntake capture).

row_name.description: Custom name for this permit line item row

locality_office_id.description: Optional stable ID of the office in PermitLocality.offices. Blank for legacy or unresolved rows; never a shared government office/catalog ID.

office_type.description: LEGACY — single office type. Use office_types (array) instead.

status.description: Current status of this line item

steps.description: Custom workflow steps with checkboxes and dates

tied_to_step_id.description: Optional — links a non-checkbox step to a checkbox step that marks completion.

permit_received_date.description: When the permit was received — marks complete

application_reference_number.description: Application, case, tracking, or reference number for this individual permit/office line. Line-level; does not overwrite legacy WorkOrder permit fields.

permit_number.description: Issued permit number for this individual permit/office line. Line-level; does not overwrite the legacy WorkOrder permit_number field.

permit_document_url.description: Link to the issued permit document (PDF/image) for this line — staff pastes the file or portal URL here.

approval_date.description: Date this individual permit/office line was approved, when approval is distinct from permit receipt/issuance.

expiration_date.description: Expiration date for this individual permit/office line, when provided by the issuing authority.

jurisdiction_fee_amount.description: Actual known jurisdiction/permit-office fee for this individual line, entered or reconciled by staff. Never auto-filled from repository fee guidance or estimator permit_fee.

jurisdiction_fee_status.description: Staff-recorded payment state for the actual jurisdiction fee. Blank means not recorded; no status is inferred from repository data.

jurisdiction_fee_paid_date.description: Date the actual jurisdiction fee for this permit line was paid, when known.

correction_status.description: Staff-recorded correction/resubmission state for this individual permit line. Blank means no correction state is currently recorded.

corrections_received_date.description: Date the issuing authority sent or communicated the latest correction request for this permit line.

resubmitted_date.description: Date the latest corrected package was resubmitted for this permit line.

closeout_status.description: Optional staff-recorded post-issuance inspection/closeout state for this individual permit line. Blank preserves legacy completion behavior and does not imply an inspection is required.

inspection_date.description: Scheduled or most recent inspection date for this individual permit line, as recorded by staff.

closeout_date.description: Date staff confirmed the permit line's required inspection/closeout work was completed.

last_submitted_trigger_date.description: Exact submitted_date value already claimed for workflow automation. Prevents duplicate permit_submitted actions while allowing a later corrected date to fire once.

last_permit_received_trigger_date.description: Exact permit_received_date value already claimed for workflow automation. Prevents duplicate permit_received actions while allowing a later corrected date to fire once.

last_followup_fired_date.description: Date the follow-up reminder was last fired (dedupe guard)

next_action.description: The next thing someone should do on this permit line — e.g. 'Call the office Friday to chase approval'. Free text, staff-entered.

inspector_contact.description: Inspector name/phone for the scheduled inspection.

submission_method.description: How the application was submitted to the office — portal / email / fax / in-person / mail.

urgent.description: Staff-marked urgent — rises to the top of the permit queue.

follow_up_date.description: Staff-set 'check back on this' date — the chase reminder.

expected_response_date.description: The office's stated turnaround — 'expected reply/decision by this date'.

fee_payment_link.description: The office's online-payment URL for this permit's fee — saved so staff never hunt it down twice.

application_revision.description: How many times this application has been sent back and resubmitted — starts at 1.

denial_date.description: Date the office denied the application, when applicable.

denial_reason.description: The office's stated reason for denial — recorded verbatim so resubmission learns from it.

appeal_deadline.description: Appeal/resubmission deadline after a denial, when one applies.

applied_by.description: Who applied this jurisdiction to the job — the accountability field.

application_document_url.description: The application packet/PDF filed (or drafted) for this line — the document rides with the record.

site_photo_url.description: Site photo of the posted sign — rides with the permit for final inspection.

office_contacted_date.description: Date staff last contacted the office (call/email).

office_responded_date.description: Date the office last replied — the response loop closes visibly.

note_attachment_url.description: Photo/scan attached to the line's notes — the record stays visual.

variance_required.description: The office requires a variance (sign exceeds the standard rules) — a separate approval path.

variance_status.description: Variance tracking: applied / hearing date / approved / denied.

variance_hearing_date.description: Date of the variance hearing, when scheduled.

correction_required.description: Office issued a correction notice — something must be fixed before the permit clears.

correction_deadline.description: Deadline to fix the correction notice before the application lapses.

correction_resolved_date.description: Date the correction was fixed and resubmitted.

confirmation_number.description: The office's submission reference/confirmation number, recorded at submit time.

PermittingOfficeAuthorityReview.name: PermittingOfficeAuthorityReview
PermittingOfficeAuthorityReview.description: Immutable staff-reviewed office role and explicit jurisdiction coverage. Event creation plus a matching committed profile receipt records the decision; fresh evidence checks determine current verification. Never establishes address authority or changes job workflows.

all_day.description: Whether this is an all-day event

assigned_to.description: List of user emails assigned to this event

is_universal.description: Visible to all users on the universal company calendar

travel_buffer_minutes.description: Travel/buffer minutes treated as busy time before and after the event for conflict checks

external_id.description: ID from external calendar (Outlook/Google) for dedup

FoundationProject.name: FoundationProject
FoundationProject.description: Concrete | Masonry | Poles estimator project. Holds foundation items (spread footings / pillars) with concrete, rebar, excavation, forming and finishing costs, plus placed poles, masonry walls, wall caps, signage cabinets, site landscaping, selected equipment and the rolled-up totals.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

builder_sync_attempt.description: Internal source-save receipt; synchronization is acknowledged by the linked estimate line at the same source updated_date.

x_inches.description: Left/right position on the layout canvas, in inches.

z_inches.description: Front/back position on the layout canvas, in inches.

reinforcement_calculation_version.description: Absent or 1 uses legacy reinforcement; 2 uses the explicitly accepted preliminary model. Unsupported versions must not fall back to legacy pricing.

reinforcement_design.description: Accepted versioned raw reinforcement geometry. Not engineering approval, structural capacity or a stock purchasing schedule.

reinforcement_material.description: Explicit stable catalog identity or authored manual per-foot material basis for the accepted reinforcement design.

reinforcement_proposal.description: Unapplied versioned editor draft, including incomplete raw text. Never authoritative for live pricing or downstream material handoff.

reinforcement_cost_snapshot.description: Latest deterministic version-2 steel quantities, material/labor amounts and basis. Builder frozen pricing is separate; engineering and procurement approval remain false.

reinforcement_acceptance.description: Historical local model-acceptance receipt with origin actor, source, component, revision, timestamp and warnings. Audit metadata only, never authorization or engineering approval.

selected_pole_id.description: LEGACY item-level pole selection (CMP-E01). Never priced — the canonical representation is project.poles; migrate via the Poles panel.

pole_offset_from_bottom_inches.description: LEGACY item-level pole offset above the footing bottom. Not interpreted as embedment.

pole_total_height_inches.description: LEGACY item-level total pole height in inches. Never priced — see project.poles.

include_pole_painting.description: LEGACY item-level pole-painting flag; the canonical flag lives on project.poles rows.

rebar_material_cost.description: Calculated version-2 steel material cost, separate from reinforcement labor.

rebar_labor_hours.description: Recorded version-2 reinforcement labor hours; absent is unknown, not zero.

rebar_geometry_feet.description: Physical modeled steel footage, distinct from the priced rebar_feet override.

rebar_geometry_weight_lbs.description: Physical modeled steel weight, distinct from the priced rebar_weight_lbs.

rebar_connection_count.description: Modeled reinforcement connections, independent of an aggregate priced-footage override.

pole_cost.description: LEGACY item-level pole cost snapshot — never summed into totals (poles are priced on project.poles only, CMP-E01).

pole_painting_cost.description: LEGACY item-level pole painting cost snapshot — never summed into totals.

height_inches.description: Height of the pole above finished grade in inches — a distinct required quantity (CMP-E02).

y_offset_inches.description: Legacy spelling of embedment below grade in inches; the canonical field is embedment_inches. When both are recorded they must agree.

embedment_inches.description: Canonical depth of the pole below finished grade in inches; supersedes the legacy y_offset_inches spelling of the same quantity.

base_offset_inches.description: Height of the pole's base above finished grade (wall/pier mounting). Placement metadata only — never contributes to billed material length.

total_length_inches.description: Explicit purchased/billed total stock length override; when recorded it is the billed length instead of height above grade plus embedment.

required_length_inches.description: Calculated billed material length snapshot — the explicit total stock length when recorded, else height above grade plus embedment.

stock_pieces.description: Calculated stock-piece count under the catalog stock_price pricing mode; null under per-foot pricing.

pole_shape.description: Actual cross-section shape (round/square/rectangular/elliptical/other or a catalog value); falls back to the catalog row's pole_shape when unrecorded.

include_pole_painting.description: Canonical pole-painting flag consumed by the priced path (the 'paint' boolean is a legacy alias not read by pricing).

custom_cost_per_unit.description: Per-pole rate override — $/linear foot or $/stock piece depending on the catalog row's pole_pricing_mode.

pole_name.description: Calculated snapshot of the resolved catalog material name.

migrated_from.description: Provenance marker; 'legacy_item' when the row was created from legacy item-level pole fields (CMP-E01).

source_item_component_id.description: Foundation item this pole was migrated from, when migrated_from is set.

legacy_pole_offset_from_bottom_inches.description: Preserved legacy item field — offset of the pole above the footing bottom. Never interpreted as embedment.

wall_caps.description: Wall cap pieces placed on top of outer walls.

length_inches.description: Actual cut length used. May be shorter than stock; full stock is still charged.

lateral_offset_inches.description: Side-to-side offset from wall centerline (negative = outer side)

signage_cabinets.description: Signage cabinets mounted directly on a foundation or on a placed pole.

landscape.description: Site landscaping painted on the landscape designer grid. cells maps 'x,y' grid keys to a material key; cell_size_inches is the size of one cell.

customer_markup_percent.description: Markup applied to this section's cost to reach the customer price.

customer_price_override.description: Manual customer price for this section; overrides the markup calculation when set.

customer_pricing.description: Optional saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Manual Foundation markup/override remains the fallback until a tier is explicitly applied.

pricing_engine.description: F-23h: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge}. When present, foundationPricingWire routes the sell side through the shared engine; absent = legacy pricing verbatim.

concrete_delivery_snapshot.description: Versioned historical order snapshot saved atomically with the source design; never current pricing when catalog items are unavailable.

WorkOrderTimeEntry.name: WorkOrderTimeEntry
WorkOrderTimeEntry.description: Product-scoped job time tracking (CoreBridge parity): one row per labor session a staff member logs against a single product inside a WorkOrder — started/stopped timestamps, department bucket (design|production|fabrication|installation), computed duration, and a timer|manual provenance. Rows with empty stopped_at are live running timers; stopped rows carry duration_seconds. Corrections void a row (status=voided) rather than editing history. Backend-only — created/read/updated via service-role functions; frontends never touch the entity facade directly.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one timer session — `${work_order_id}:${product_id}:${user_email}:${yyyymmddhhmm}` bucket — so a double-click or a lost create response never double-writes a session.

work_order_id.description: Parent WorkOrder id — the primary filter/grouping key for a job's time entries (queries always filter on this first).

product_id.description: id inside WorkOrder.products[] (or the linked BuilderProduct id) the labor session was logged against.

user_email.description: Email of the staff member who ran the timer / logged the manual entry.

department.description: Department bucket the labor counts against — drives the products[] design_time_seconds / production_time_seconds rollup.

stopped_at.description: ISO timestamp the session ended; EMPTY means the timer is still running (at most one running row per user+product).

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds, computed when the timer stops (stopped_at - started_at). 0 while running or for zero-length sessions.

source.description: How the entry was recorded — live timer Start/Stop, or a manual time log.

note.description: Free-form context — what the staff member worked on.

status.description: Lifecycle state — active rows count in rollups; voided rows are kept for audit but contribute no time.

PricingModifier.name: PricingModifier
PricingModifier.description: CoreBridge-style custom property / variable-rate modifier attachable to catalog parts and estimate lines. A modifier captures extra input (text, number, select, checkbox, or formula) and can adjust price via rate tables, a formula, setup fees, minimum charges, and waste factors.

name.description: Internal modifier name (unique key used in formulas and part configuration).

label.description: Customer/operator-facing label shown on the estimate input form.

input_type.description: Input widget type: text | number | select | checkbox | formula. 'select' options come from ModifierOption rows; 'formula' derives its value from formula_text instead of user input.

can_use_in_pricing.description: When true this modifier's value/rates may feed the pricing waterfall.

rates.description: Variable rate table rows: {label:string, retail:number, cost:number, per_unit:string}. Selected/matched row supplies the retail and cost rates and the unit basis the rate applies to.

formula_text.description: Formula expression (CoreBridge variable-rate syntax) evaluated when input_type is formula or when pricing derives from modifier inputs.

include_setup_fee.description: When true the modifier contributes a flat setup fee in addition to its unit-rate price.

min_charge.description: Floor for this modifier's total price contribution; 0 = no minimum.

affects_waste.description: When true the modifier value scales the part's waste/overage factor.

inventoried_part_type.description: Optional part-type key limiting which inventoried catalog parts this modifier may attach to.

pricing_tier_id.description: Optional PricingTierMatrix/tier row scoping this modifier's rates to a customer pricing tier.

display_order.description: Order the modifier input renders within its part's modifier list.

status.description: Lifecycle status (e.g. active, archived). Free-form string; treated as active when unset.

MaintenanceInventory.name: MaintenanceInventory
MaintenanceInventory.description: Materials catalog for the Sign Maintenance estimator, scoped by sign type, size and action, with size-tiered or per-unit pricing.

applies_to_item_types.description: Sign / service item types this material applies to. Empty array = applies to all.

applies_to_sizes.description: Letter sizes (for channel/dimensional) AND cabinet sizes (for monument/pylon/P&P) this material applies to. Empty = all.

applies_to_actions.description: Maintenance actions this material applies to. Empty = all.

inventory_entity.description: Master Inventory entity that owns the linked resource and authoritative cost.

inventory_item_id.description: ID of the linked Master Inventory resource.

inventory_item_name.description: Cached display name of the linked Master Inventory resource.

usage_basis.description: Estimator quantity basis used to convert service-item dimensions/counts into Master Inventory usage.

usage_multiplier.description: Master Inventory units consumed per usage-basis unit.

usage_rounding.description: Optional quantity rounding applied after usage multiplication.

is_active.description: Whether this Maintenance material rule is active.

save_attempt_id.description: Opaque correlation ID for field audit events prepared in one local WorkOrder save attempt; not proof of successful write.

save_attempt_baseline_version.description: WorkOrder updated_date read before local save CAS; not a commit receipt.

backup_type.description: Whether backup was manual or scheduled

data_types.description: List of data types backed up

triggered_by.description: User email who triggered (or 'system' for scheduled)

user_email.description: Staff email these notification preferences belong to (lowercased AuthorizedEmail.email)

schema_version.description: Preference blob schema version for client-side migration

hidden_sections.description: Attention-feed section keys this user turned off in the prefs popover

section_snoozed_until.description: Map of feed section key -> epoch ms; snoozed sections hide until their timestamp passes

dismissed_feed_items.description: Per-item feed overlays: {id, handled_at, snoozed_until} — handled items hide permanently, snoozed until their timestamp. Bounded to the newest 300.

sound_on.description: Play the subtle notification beep when a new persisted notification arrives

digest_opt_in.description: Receive the once-a-day in-app digest notification summarizing the attention feed

last_digest_date.description: Client-local YYYY-MM-DD the last digest notification was recorded for — server skips a second digest the same day

last_evaluated_at.description: Server-side throttle marker for evaluate_triggers — heavy detectors run at most once per interval per user

creation_request_key.description: Deterministic first-create key (notifpref:<email>) so concurrent first writes dedupe

last_request_id.description: Idempotency request id of the most recent preference update

subscriptions.description: Per-user alert subscriptions (H-12). Entries {event_key, criteria:{field:value}, delivery:'feed'|'digest'|'both', enabled, created_by/at, updated_by/at}; dedupe by event_key+criteria signature; bounded to 200 — base44/shared/alertSubscriptionsModel.ts canonicalizes.

ChannelLetterInstallation.name: ChannelLetterInstallation
ChannelLetterInstallation.description: Channel Letter Installation estimator project — letters purchased/fabricated, install items, install equipment (with idle running), personnel, travel, supplies and markup.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

idle_hours.description: Hours this boom equipment will idle running on-site (added on top of the rental/flat rate).

customer_pricing.description: Saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Preserves selected tier, category breakdown, volume discount and final customer price without changing internal Builder cost.

pricing_engine.description: F-23a: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge}. When present, channelPricingWire routes the sell side through the shared engine; absent = legacy pricing verbatim.

OpportunityIntake.name: OpportunityIntake
OpportunityIntake.description: Immutable/provenance-oriented inbound source event for an Opportunity. Multiple intake events may resolve to one Opportunity. Captured source values are evidence, not a parallel Customer database.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one captured intake event.

opportunity_id.description: Resolved Opportunity id when this intake has been linked. May be blank while identity/resolution is pending.

source_external_id.description: Stable source-system identity when available. Never substitute row position or customer name for a real external id.

source_fingerprint.description: Deterministic normalized source fingerprint when the source supports one.

raw_source_reference.description: Reference to preserved raw source evidence rather than an unnecessary duplicate copy.

captured_fields.description: Captured/unverified business fields such as customer/contact/site/job requirements. Never store full card numbers, CVV/CVC, banking credentials, or payment authentication secrets here.

InventoryMovement.name: InventoryMovement
InventoryMovement.description: Append-only audit ledger for stock changes on Master Inventory items. All writes go through inventoryAction — never edited directly.

creation_request_key.description: Retry-safe key; a repeated request must resolve to this same movement.

item_id.description: Inventory record id this movement applies to.

item_label.description: Frozen item description at movement time (material/type/size) for audit readability.

reason.description: receive = stock received in; issue = consumed on a job; adjust = manual correction; return = job stock returned; reserve = stock committed to an approved estimate.

estimate_id.description: AllInOneEstimate this movement reserved or issued stock for, when applicable.

unit_cost.description: Item cost_per_unit frozen at movement time, for issued-material costing.

resulting_qty.description: On-hand quantity immediately after this movement.

work_order_id.description: Job the stock was issued to / returned from, when applicable.

CustomerSummary.name: CustomerSummary
CustomerSummary.description: A saved multi-module summary for a client, bundling projects from different estimator modules under one tier.

summary_key.description: Internal deterministic key used only for concurrency-safe Customer Summary creation. Historical summary rows are not required to have it.

linked_projects.description: List of projects from different modules included in this summary.

BouncieConnection.name: BouncieConnection
BouncieConnection.description: Stores the Bouncie OAuth tokens for the company fleet account plus integration health. A single shared connection record is used; the most recently updated record is treated as active. Tokens are only ever read server-side.

access_token.description: Bouncie API access token. Server-side only; never exposed through normal client entity reads.

refresh_token.description: Bouncie OAuth refresh token used to obtain new access tokens. Server-side only; never exposed through normal client entity reads.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the access token expires.

user_email.description: Email of the Bouncie account holder.

user_name.description: Name of the Bouncie account holder.

connected_by.description: Email of the app admin who initiated the connection.

needs_reconnect.description: True when the refresh token is no longer accepted and an admin must reauthorize.

last_error.description: Last Bouncie API/token error message (never contains secrets).

last_sync_at.description: Last successful Bouncie REST API call.

last_webhook_at.description: Last successfully processed Bouncie webhook event.

last_webhook_event.description: Event type of the last processed webhook.

webhook_id.description: Bouncie webhook id registered for this app.

refresh_claim_token.description: One-refresh-at-a-time claim marker. Set while a service-role caller owns the in-flight token refresh; cleared when it completes.

refresh_claim_at.description: When the refresh claim was taken; claims older than ~30 seconds are treated as stale.

name.description: Display label for this matrix row, e.g. 'Retail / Banners qty breaks'.

status.description: Inactive rows are ignored by the pricing engine.

customer_tier.description: MarkupTier this row applies to — tier_name, tier_number, or record id. Blank means the row is a category-wide default that applies to every tier.

category.description: Sign category key (MarkupCategory.category_key) this row prices. Blank means the row is a tier-wide default covering every category.

markup_pct.description: Markup percent over unit cost. 50 = sell at cost x 1.50. Ignored when a matching per_unit_breaks bracket applies.

pricing_mode.description: Pricing path for this row. 'markup' prices at markup_pct over unit cost. 'market' prices at market_retail less market_discount_pct; a qualifying per_unit_breaks bracket still wins when it prices lower than the market price.

market_retail.description: Market-based pricing: prevailing retail unit price this row tracks. Required for pricing_mode = 'market'; a market row without it falls back to markup pricing.

market_discount_pct.description: Market-based pricing: percent off market_retail. 10 = sell at 90% of retail.

minimum_charge.description: Line-level floor price. When the computed extension lands above zero but below this amount, the line is raised to the minimum.

per_unit_breaks.description: Quantity price breaks: when qty >= bracket qty, the bracket unit_price replaces markup_pct pricing.

qty.description: Minimum quantity that unlocks this bracket.

unit_price.description: Sell price per unit inside this bracket.

formula_modifiers.description: Ordered unit-price adjustments applied after markup/market/break resolution, evaluated left to right. Each item: {type: 'add_pct'|'mul'|'add_flat'|'min'|'max', value} — add_pct: price x (1+value/100); mul: price x value; add_flat: price + value; min: floor at value; max: cap at value.

effective_from.description: First date (YYYY-MM-DD) this row is effective. Blank = no start bound.

effective_to.description: Last date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) this row is effective. Blank = no end bound.

updated_by.description: Email of the staff user who last saved this row (audit).

updated_note.description: Optional change note left by the last editor (audit).

Inventory.name: Inventory
Inventory.description: Extruded / sheet metal stock catalog used by the Metal Fabrication estimator. Rows flagged is_pole are also selectable as sign poles in the Foundation estimator.

is_pole.description: When true, this extruded-metal row is also available to the Concrete | Masonry | Poles estimator as a sign pole. Geometry is auto-derived from product_type + size, $/ft from cost_per_unit, and paint rate from the global Foundation Settings.

legacy_source_id.description: Original SignEstimate Pro legacy Inventory record ID for compatibility rows.

legacy_compatibility.description: Internal compatibility row retained for Git-era Metal estimator behavior; hidden from the modern Master Inventory catalog.

quantity_on_hand.description: Current stock on hand. Updated only through inventoryAction with compare-and-set guards.

reorder_point.description: On-hand level at or below which the item is flagged for reorder.

image_url.description: Optional image URL for this inventory item.

barcode.description: Optional barcode/UPC value for scan-to-lookup on the Inventory page.

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag — archived items are hidden from stock lists, pickers, and reorder suggestions.

income_account.description: GL income account code this item's sales post to on accounting export (CoreBridge-style Manage Accounts mapping).

cogs_account.description: GL cost-of-goods-sold account code this item's consumption posts to on accounting export.

is_kit.description: When true, this row is a kit/bundle definition rather than a stocked part. Kit rows are selectable in the estimate Add Product flow and expand into their component inventory lines.

kit_items.description: Component lines for kit rows: [{inventory_item_id, quantity}].

kit_price.description: Optional explicit kit sell price. When blank, kit pricing is the sum of component cost_per_unit x quantity.

name.description: Sub-item name/text

applies_to_product_types.description: Product types this sub-item applies to

field_name.description: Name of the field that was changed

changed_by_email.description: Email of user who made the change

changed_by_name.description: Name of user who made the change

EstimatingRequest.name: EstimatingRequest
EstimatingRequest.description: Controlled, auditable handoff from Opportunity/Intake into Estimating. The verified handoff_snapshot freezes what Sales knew when the request was submitted while current Customer/Contact/Location records remain live.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one Estimating Request.

contact_id.description: Future canonical CustomerContact id when resolved.

location_id.description: Future canonical CustomerLocation/site id when resolved.

estimate_id.description: Linked AllInOneEstimate once the request creates or is attached to an Estimate.

compatibility_work_order_id.description: Transitional WorkOrder-backed Sales Pipeline link during compatibility migration.

handoff_snapshot.description: Point-in-time verified packet delivered to Estimating. Persistence guards freeze this once the request leaves draft.

due_date.description: Optional estimate-request due date; the attention feed flags open requests past this date as overdue.

request_kind.description: Optional machine-readable classification for why the request exists (e.g. quote_rejection_followup for a staff quote rejection follow-up, portal_decline / portal_revision for customer-portal follow-ups).

FileBridgeCommand.name: FileBridgeCommand
FileBridgeCommand.description: Command queue — the source of truth for every agent action (list_dir, fetch_bytes, deep_search, uploads, mutations). Staff enqueue via fileBridgeAction; agents lease/execute/complete via fileBridgeIngest. dedupe_key collapses identical in-flight requests.

tier_number.description: Tier number 1-8. 1 = General Public (highest markup), 8 = Friends & Family (lowest).

description.description: Optional notes about when to use this tier.

markups.description: Markup multiplier per category_key. Stored as numbers, e.g. 1.50 = 50% markup. Keys come from MarkupCategory.category_key.

name.description: Machine label, e.g. '54in Vinyl Plotter', 'CNC Router Table A'.

machine_type.description: Equipment class this rate row prices.

setup_minutes.description: One-time setup minutes billed at the runtime rate each time the machine is used.

runtime_rate_per_hour.description: Machine rate in $ per runtime hour (also bills setup time).

maintenance_rate_per_hour.description: Additional $ per runtime hour covering wear, blades/bits, and maintenance.

material_waste_pct.description: Percent of the job's material cost added to cover machine spoilage/waste.

status.description: Inactive machine rows are ignored by the pricing engine.

source_title.description: Cached source document title for display.

check_method.description: Primary cheap-check method used. Hash is the fallback when headers are absent.
