last_changed.description: When a change was last detected.

last_change_summary.description: JSON summary of the last change: old/new hash, old/new content length, changed-links set, AI regulatory-impact assessment, affected rules count.

staff_review_required.description: True when staff review is needed (regulatory impact or broken source).

schedule_cadence.description: Check cadence. volatile=weekly, moderate=monthly, stable=quarterly, immutable=yearly.

next_check_due.description: When the next scan should run. Computed from last_successful_check + cadence.

monitor_enabled.description: Whether this source is actively monitored. Boone County only for the initial pass.

ProductSubstatus.name: ProductSubstatus

Backend-only — read/written via service-role functions.

name.description: Tag label as stored on products[].quick_tags[] (e.g. 'Rush', 'Waiting on Customer').

color.description: Hex display color for the tag chip (e.g. '#f59e0b').

applies_to.description: Module keys this tag is offered in (e.g. design, production, installation); empty means the tag is offered in every module.

sort.description: Display ordering of this tag in the picklist.

status.description: Lifecycle state — active | archived.

user_email.description: Employee email these workspace preferences belong to

schema_version.description: Preference blob schema version for client-side migration

preferences.description: Consolidated workspace preference blob: appearance, density, navigation/taskbar, landing page, page views, accessibility. Shape defined by src/components/layout/workspacePrefs.js

profiles.description: Named saved preference snapshots the employee can switch between

creation_request_key.description: Deterministic first-create key so concurrent first writes dedupe

last_request_id.description: Idempotency request id of the most recent preference update

LaserProject.name: LaserProject
LaserProject.description: Laser estimator project — cut/engrave items priced off machine and labor rates for the parameter and engraving lasers.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

builder_item_id.description: Stable hidden estimator row identity used only for Product/Part reconciliation. Existing rows are seeded from their legacy array index; new rows use generated IDs.

engrave_area_sqin.description: Area in square inches for engraving

fixed_setup_hours.description: Fixed setup time for the entire project in hours.

fixed_material_setup_cost.description: Fixed material setup cost for the entire project.

customer_pricing.description: Saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Preserves selected tier, category breakdown, volume discount and final customer price without changing internal Builder cost.

pricing_engine.description: F-23e: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge}. When present, laserPricingWire routes the sell side through the shared engine; absent = legacy pricing verbatim.

ProductActivity.name: ProductActivity
ProductActivity.description: Append-only per-product audit trail: operational_status/substatus changes, proof events, due-date moves, assignment and priority edits, notes, estimate→WO conversions, and manual overrides — one row per product change, written by service-role backends (product history tab / order history feeds read it). Rows are immutable; corrections are new rows, never edits.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one audit row so a lost create response never double-writes history.

work_order_id.description: Parent WorkOrder id — the primary filter/grouping key for a job's product history (queries always filter on this first).

product_id.description: id inside WorkOrder.products[] (or the linked BuilderProduct id) the event concerns.

product_label.description: Display name of the product captured at write time so history stays readable after renames.

actor_type.description: Actor class — drives order-history coloring (staff black / customer green / vendor blue / system grey).

actor_label.description: Display name or email of who caused the event; system rows name the function/sync that wrote them.

from_value.description: Value before the change, string-rendered (empty when not applicable, e.g. notes/conversions).

note.description: Free-form context — note text for note events, override reason, or extra detail.

occurred_at.description: ISO timestamp the change happened; history sorts on this (chronological).

details.description: Structured extras: which product field changed, patch keys, proof version, source module.

FileBridgeSpikeRow.name: FileBridgeSpikeRow
FileBridgeSpikeRow.description: THROWAWAY — FB-02 probe entity for bulk-write and write-speed measurements. Delete before publish.

FleetSystemReport.name: FleetSystemReport
FleetSystemReport.description: Fleet-scoped bug/feature/change report history. Separate from CCS estimator/workflow report systems.

creation_key.description: Stable client-generated idempotency key for a logical Fleet feedback create operation.

PricingTemplate.name: PricingTemplate
PricingTemplate.description: Named quantity-break x customer-tier margin chart scoped to a unit category (CoreBridge 'Pricing Templates' analog — 17 seed reference shapes). A catalog part selects a template on its Pricing Tiers tab; the pricing engine resolves the matching qty bracket, then applies the customer's tier markup_pct — or the market-based retail/discount chart when market_based is set. Backend-only: all access goes through staffEntityWrite/admin functions.

name.description: Display label for this margin chart, e.g. 'Banner SqFt — Standard' or 'Retail Parts qty chart'.

unit_category.description: Pricing-unit category this chart covers (SqFt, LinFt, Each, Hourly, Pixels, ...). Only parts whose pricing unit matches may select this template.

breaks.description: Quantity brackets in ascending qty order. When order qty >= bracket qty, that bracket's tier_markups chart applies.

qty.description: Minimum quantity that unlocks this bracket.

tier_markups.description: Markup percent per customer tier for this bracket, keyed by MarkupTier.tier_name (e.g. {"General Public": 50, "Wholesale": 30}). Values are markup_pct numbers where 50 = sell at cost x 1.50.

market_based.description: When true, tier_markups values are interpreted as market-based retail/discount chart entries instead of cost-plus markup percents.

description.description: Optional admin notes on when or where this chart should be used.

status.description: Inactive templates are hidden from pickers and ignored by the pricing engine.

EstimateRevision.name: EstimateRevision
EstimateRevision.description: Estimate-level audit trail for customer-facing lifecycle transitions and revisions. Product/Part pricing history remains in BuilderPriceRevision; this entity records the whole-estimate before/after snapshot, reason, status and quote totals when an estimate is sent, approved, archived, cancelled, converted, or intentionally revised after protection.

quote_version.description: Customer quote version associated with this lifecycle revision, when one has been issued.

quote_issue_key.description: Stable identity linking this lifecycle revision to the corresponding issued customer quote version and delivery/acceptance audit records.

delivery_evidence.description: Fallback evidence for the first delivery of this issued quote version (delivery id when available, Gmail id, recipient, archive URL/fingerprint, and sent timestamp). Preserves traceability if the dedicated delivery audit row cannot be saved.

idempotency_key.description: Stable internal key for retry-safe lifecycle events. Kept separate from revision_number and customer Quote Version; notes remains populated for backward-compatible audit lookup.

CatalogPartGroup.name: CatalogPartGroup
CatalogPartGroup.description: Catalog-level part grouping for shared configuration inheritance. Unlike BuilderPartGroup (an ordered group inside one Builder Product on a single estimate), a CatalogPartGroup is a reusable registry row: it lists member catalog part ids and carries shared_defaults — a JSON bag of inheritable part fields that members adopt unless they override locally.

name.description: Display name of the catalog part group.

shared_defaults.description: JSON of inheritable part fields applied to every member part that has not overridden the field locally (e.g. pricing mode, margin, vendor, waste factor).

part_ids.description: Ids of the catalog parts that belong to this group and inherit shared_defaults.

sort.description: Display order of this group in catalog pickers.

status.description: Lifecycle status (e.g. active, archived). Free-form string; treated as active when unset.

SignLightingInventory.name: SignLightingInventory
SignLightingInventory.description: Sign lighting catalog — LED modules, strips, neon, power supplies, drivers, transformers, ballasts, fluorescent tubes, photocells, and timers. Used by Channel Letters, Sign Maintenance, and any module that needs to spec illumination.

color_temperature_k.description: For LEDs/tubes — color temperature in Kelvin (e.g. 6500 = cool white).

modules_per_run.description: For LED modules — max modules per parallel run before voltage drop.

user_email.description: Email the session belongs to.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the session token — the raw token is never stored.

FileShareRoot.name: FileShareRoot
FileShareRoot.description: Configured Unraid share root for the File Bridge. One row per (agent_id, root_key). All access via fileBridgeIngest/fileBridgeAction — backend-only.

rel_root.description: Server-relative mount path e.g. 'share/Customer Files' (never /mnt/user in UI).

unc_path.description: Optional UNC for Open-in-Explorer e.g. '\\\\TOWER\\share\\Customer Files'.

extraction_enabled.description: FTS5 content extraction opt-in per root.

user_email.description: User's email

hourly_cost_rate.description: Internal hourly cost rate for capacity costing — admin-facing only

module_name.description: The unique identifier for the module.

is_enabled.description: Whether the module is currently active.

Vendor.name: Vendor
Vendor.description: Vendor registry — canonical supplier record (contacts, payment terms, default GL account, communication preferences, statement email). PurchaseOrder.vendor_id links here; vendor_name stays on the PO for display. Backend-only access.

gl_default.description: Default GL account code for purchases from this vendor.

default_cost.description: Vendor-level fallback unit cost used when the part carries no vendor_cost (vendorCostModel precedence: part vendor_cost > vendor default_cost > part cost).

default_markup_percent.description: Vendor-level fallback retail markup percent for supplied parts; overridden by part vendor_markup_percent.

default_markup_flat.description: Vendor-level fallback flat markup added after percent for supplied parts; overridden by part vendor_markup_flat.

statement_email.description: Email address vendor statements are sent to.

account_number.description: Our account number on file with this vendor.

PermitResolutionRule.name: PermitResolutionRule
PermitResolutionRule.description: Reusable jurisdiction-resolution rules minted by review decisions. When a flagged address gets resolved (staff pick or verified evidence), a rule row is written so every FUTURE lookup of the same pattern resolves automatically — reviews generalize instead of fixing one address.

rule_type.description: postal_name_map: entered/postal city X -> jurisdiction Y within a county. address_override: one parcel-confirmed address -> jurisdiction. source_preference: for a county, prefer a boundary source when sources conflict.

entered_name.description: For postal_name_map: the city name as written on addresses (e.g. 'Amelia', 'Cincinnati'). Normalized for matching.

address_key.description: For address_override: the normalized full address string.

county.description: Parent county name the rule is scoped to (e.g. 'Hamilton County'). Blank = statewide.

jurisdiction_name.description: The jurisdiction this rule resolves to (e.g. 'Pierce township', 'Central City').

geoid.description: Census/state GEOID of the resolved jurisdiction when known.

preferred_source.description: For source_preference: which boundary source to trust on conflicts ('state' or 'census').

source.description: How the rule was minted. staff_review = a human reviewed a flag.

evidence.description: Address + trace context that produced the rule.

created_from_address.description: The flagged address whose resolution minted this rule.

active.description: Set false to retire a rule without deleting it.

FleetWarranty.name: FleetWarranty
FleetWarranty.description: Fleet asset/component warranty coverage and expiration tracking.

site_survey_am_pm.description: AM or PM for site survey

notes.description: Notes with timestamps and completion status

status.description: Form status

name.description: Name of the county or locality

html_evidence_state.description: Durable manual HTML evidence reservation/receipt. Unknown creates reconcile the same source hash without repeating creation. Does not modify documents, reviewed authority or automated queue accounting.

office_research.description: Unverified role-by-role office and electrical research findings. No canonical office assignment, authority approval or client/job change is implied.

office_authority_review_state.description: Durable reservation and committed sequence for immutable PermittingOfficeAuthorityReview events. Creating/uncertain reservations reconcile only by the same saved request; no blind repeated create. Office identity/role/scope never resolves an address automatically.

cagis_database_url.description: Property/parcel lookup database URL (CAGIS or equivalent)

billing_address.description: The office's invoice/remit address — where the permit fee check goes.

photo_urls.description: Photos/scans of the office's posted requirements — evidence attachments.

outcome.description: What the office said — 'permits take 2 weeks'

call_outcome_log.description: Per-office call outcomes — the tribal knowledge stays with the jurisdiction.

fips_code.description: Federal FIPS place/county code — machine-verifiable identity, not just a name.

ordinance_citation.description: The governing code section — 'Milford Codified §153.042' — as structured data, not buried in notes.

required_documents.description: The office's own required-fields/documents list — 'drawings, site plan, contractor license' — stored verbatim so staff know what the application needs.

ai_summary.description: AI-generated summary of sign permit requirements

activity_log.description: History of changes to this jurisdiction profile

superseded.description: This source is outdated (form replaced, page moved) — kept for audit, not cited.

catalog_state.description: Durable evidence-catalog registration receipt. creating/create_uncertain may only reconcile an existing catalog row; never repeat creation blindly.

archive_state.description: Durable archival receipt and lease. uploading/upload_uncertain must never auto-retry; uploaded resumes readback of the same file. No regulatory authority is implied.

address_research_review.description: Administrator-reviewed immutable original snapshot link; not rule or office authority approval.

archive_pinned.description: Prevents automatic archival changes to this document.

external_referral_provenance.description: Exact official-page external document referral and collection recheck; authority and applicability remain unapproved.

resource_classification.description: Deterministic MIME/signature routing hint bound to source_url. Not an archive, currentness, applicability or authority approval.

permit_requirements.description: Structured permit requirements extracted by AI

parent_county.description: Parent county information for non-county jurisdictions

_manual_requirements.description: Flag: permit requirements were manually edited

rewrite_authority.description: Jurisdiction-specific authority evidence for a comprehensive zoning/sign-regulation rewrite. Permitting Intelligence must retain currently adopted authority unless adoption and effective-date/applicability are both independently verified for this same jurisdiction.

jurisdiction_id.description: Canonical JurisdictionProfile record ID this authority evidence applies to. When present it must match this record before rewrite promotion.

jurisdiction_name.description: Jurisdiction name recorded with the authority evidence for review and name-based matching when no canonical ID is available.

adoptionStatus.description: Verified only after reviewed official legislative adoption evidence for this jurisdiction.

adoption_evidence_url.description: Official legislative adoption record URL, such as an enacted ordinance or approved action record.

adoption_evidence_reference.description: Ordinance number, resolution number, meeting action, or other stable adoption reference.

adoption_verified_at.description: When the adoption evidence was reviewed and verified.

adoption_verified_by.description: Admin reviewer who verified the legislative adoption evidence.

effectiveDateStatus.description: Verified only after reviewed official evidence establishes the rewrite's effective date or present applicability for this jurisdiction.

effective_date.description: Officially established effective date when known. The status must remain not_verified if applicability/effectiveness is unresolved.

effective_date_evidence_url.description: Official source establishing the effective date or current applicability.

effective_date_verified_at.description: When effective-date/applicability evidence was reviewed and verified.

effective_date_verified_by.description: Admin reviewer who verified the effective-date/applicability evidence.

verification_notes.description: Authority-review notes and jurisdiction-specific caveats. Drafts, agendas, recommendations, placeholders, and narrow amendments must not be treated as comprehensive rewrite adoption.

verification_status.description: Human review status. Verified means staff confirmed the record against official/current sources; historical means retain as reference but re-verify before use.

verified_at.description: When staff last marked this jurisdiction verified against official/current sources.

verified_by.description: Employee who last verified this jurisdiction.

verification_notes.description: Optional staff notes describing verification scope, source, or caveats.

discovery_scan_state.description: URL-bound deterministic discovery frontier. Pending pages, visited URLs and unresolved gaps commit atomically with retained documents using profile version guards. No authority or locality completeness is implied.

VinylMachine.name: VinylMachine
VinylMachine.description: A production machine used by the Vinyl Estimator: large-format printer (HP Latex 360, etc.), vinyl cutter / plotter (Graphtec), laminator, or print-and-cut combo. Holds machine geometry, run-cost settings, and ink / blade economics.

print_cost_per_sqin.description: Legacy/fallback ink + consumable cost per sq-in. Now superseded by tiered rates if set.

print_cost_per_sqin_draft.description: Draft / fast-mode ink cost per sq-in.

print_cost_per_sqin_production.description: Production / standard ink cost per sq-in.

print_cost_per_sqin_high_quality.description: High-quality / outdoor ink cost per sq-in. This is the DEFAULT print mode.

default_print_quality.description: Pre-selected print quality for new workflows.

TrainingAssignment.name: TrainingAssignment
TrainingAssignment.description: One employee's assignment of one TrainingItem — surfaces as a specialized row on My Workflow and in the assigned section on /sop. Training fields are snapshotted so reports stay readable if the item changes.

assigned_by.description: Email of the admin/editor who assigned it.

due_date.description: Optional ISO date the assignment is due.

completed_method.description: How it was completed — sop_ack means the SOP's own acknowledge button closed it.

expires_at.description: For certifications: completed_at + valid_months — when renewal is due.

partner_email.description: Employee whose schedule would be received

name.description: Display name of the saved filter view (unique per owner + queue lens, enforced client-side by findViewByName)

queue_lens.description: Which queue surface this view belongs to: design | production | fulfillment | all (QUEUE_LENSES in savedViewsModel.js)

page.description: Queue page/surface identifier — forward-compatible alias for queue_lens so a view can be scoped to a page rather than a lens

user_email.description: Owner email alias matching the per-user-record convention (NotificationPreference.user_email); owner_email is the field the persistence layer writes today

filters.description: Serialized filter state — always emitted in SAVED_VIEW_FILTER_KEYS order by serializeViewFilters: status, substatus, designer, responsibility, assignedTo, category, moduleKey, duePreset, search, pageSize, includeFulfilled

is_shared.description: Shared views are visible to every staff member; only the owner can overwrite or delete

pinned.description: Pinned views float to the top of the picker (C-03 server-saved views)

sort.description: Explicit ordering weight for pinned/user-arranged views; unset rows fall back to name ordering in sortViews

is_default.description: Auto-apply this view when the owner opens the queue surface

status.description: Lifecycle marker (e.g. active | archived) so views can be retired without deleting them

creation_request_key.description: Idempotent-create key written by ensureIdempotentEntityCreate (saved_queue_view:<ts>:<rand>) so a retried create dedupes instead of double-saving a view

COGSAccount.name: COGSAccount
COGSAccount.description: GL-coded cost-of-goods-sold account (5000-series chart-of-accounts row) used to classify direct job costs on invoices, estimates, and reporting. Backend-only — rows are managed exclusively through accountingAdminAction, whose seed_gl_accounts action creates the standard chart idempotently via stable creation_request_key receipts.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one seeded/managed account row (e.g. 'seed-cogs-5000').

name.description: Account display name (e.g. 'Materials COGS').

parent_account.description: Optional parent GL account code for sub-accounts; blank on top-level accounts.

status.description: Inactive accounts stay on history but are not offered for new coding.

updated_by.description: Email of the staff user who last saved this row (audit).

DocNumberCounter.name: DocNumberCounter
DocNumberCounter.description: Singleton counter backing the atomic EST-XXXXX / INV-XXXXX number generator (generateDocNumber function). One record (config_name 'default') holds the next shared sequence number. Estimates and orders draw from the same counter so numbers never overlap.

next_seq.description: Next sequence number to hand out (shared by EST- and INV- prefixed numbers).

impact_summary.description: AI-generated summary of potential impact to sign companies

is_read.description: Whether user has read this alert

read_by.description: Email of user who read the alert

notification_sent.description: Whether notification was sent to user

IncomeAccount.name: IncomeAccount
IncomeAccount.description: GL-coded income account (4000-series chart-of-accounts row) used to classify revenue on invoices, estimates, and reporting. Backend-only — rows are managed exclusively through accountingAdminAction, whose seed_gl_accounts action creates the standard chart idempotently via stable creation_request_key receipts.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one seeded/managed account row (e.g. 'seed-income-4000').

name.description: Account display name (e.g. 'Sales Income').

parent_account.description: Optional parent GL account code for sub-accounts; blank on top-level accounts.

status.description: Inactive accounts stay on history but are not offered for new coding.

updated_by.description: Email of the staff user who last saved this row (audit).

SourceCollectionQueue.name: SourceCollectionQueue
SourceCollectionQueue.description: Collection-queue row tracking source-gathering progress for one jurisdiction. Seeded with all KY and OH counties plus incorporated KY cities and OH cities/villaries. Boone County KY is marked verified_current with its completed archive summary.

parent_county_name.description: Name of the parent county for non-county jurisdictions (city/village/township), when known from the static seed list. Blank for county rows.

authority_note.description: Plain-language note about the jurisdiction's current sign-regulation authority status.

source_category.description: Primary source category being collected for this queue row.

status.description: Collection progress status.

missing_next.description: Short human-readable description of exactly what is missing next.

source_document_refs.description: List of PermittingSourceDocument record ids linked to this jurisdiction's collection.

last_activity.description: When the queue row was last updated.

research_request_id.description: Permitting Research app ResearchRequest id currently associated with this queue row.

research_requested_at.description: When the current research request was successfully created.

research_dispatch_version.description: Dispatcher contract version used to enqueue this row.

research_dispatch_token.description: Short-lived reservation token used to prevent concurrent dispatchers from enqueueing the same queue row.

research_dispatch_attempts.description: Number of automated attempts to hand this queue row to the Permitting Research app.

dispatch_rank.description: Dispatch ordering key: miles from downtown Cincinnati (Census gazetteer centroid). Lower ranks dispatch first; rows without a rank fall back to the Ohio-first ordering.

inventory_item_id.description: Referenced inventory row id (any Master Inventory entity).

changed_by.description: Email/name of the user who made the change, when known.

note.description: Context such as 'Master Inventory edit' or 'Quick add'.

FleetPublicReportThrottle.name: FleetPublicReportThrottle
FleetPublicReportThrottle.description: Server-owned abuse throttle for anonymous Fleet issue reporting. Stores only a SHA-256 request fingerprint and rolling-window counters; never stores raw IP addresses.

fingerprint_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of normalized request origin signals; no raw network address is stored.

AllInOneEstimate.name: AllInOneEstimate
AllInOneEstimate.description: A multifaceted estimate BUILT from sections. Each section is a dedicated sub-estimate created by (and owned by) this estimate in its module's own entity, edited with that module's full estimator INLINE on the same page. Project info (client, estimate #, hyperlink, site address) is shared down to every owned section automatically. Totals live-sync from the source projects via real-time subscriptions and refresh-on-open. Customer pricing waterfall (per-section adjustments → discount → contingency → fees → tax → deposit) is computed by components/estimator/allInOne/aioPricing.js. Step 1 fields come from the shared Customer / TaxGroup / EstimateOption entities. Links to the workflow through customer_id (shared Client) and work_order_id.

creation_request_key.description: Internal random receipt used only to make one New Estimate create action retry-safe. It is not derived from client/project names, so legitimate separate estimates with identical names remain allowed.

opportunity_id.description: Optional canonical Opportunity link. Blank is valid for legacy/direct-created Estimates.

split_from_estimate_id.description: Parent estimate id when this estimate was created via Split — links the child back to its source for traceability.

duplicated_from_estimate_id.description: Source estimate id when this estimate was created via Duplicate — links the clone back to its source for traceability.

estimating_request_id.description: Optional EstimatingRequest link preserving the pre-estimate handoff identity.

work_order_id.description: Optional linked WorkOrder id — ties this estimate to a job in the workflow.

sales_stage.description: Mirror of the linked WorkOrder's sales_status, written back when the pipeline stage changes (WorkOrder to estimate reverse sync). Distinct from the estimate lifecycle status field; absent on estimates that were never pipeline-linked.

sales_stage_changed_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent sales_stage write-back from the linked WorkOrder.

po_number.description: Customer purchase order number, shown on the customer quote.

delivery_method.description: Requested fulfillment/delivery method captured at quote time (A-28); seeds WorkOrder.fulfillment_method on conversion.

terms.description: Payment terms selected from the admin-managed terms list.

order_contact.description: Contact on the order (from the customer's contacts).

tax_group.description: Name of the selected TaxGroup — sets tax_percent.

site_address.description: Job site address — shared down to sections whose module supports it.

accepted_at.description: ISO timestamp of the canonical customer acceptance (mirrors the EstimateAcceptance row).

accepted_by_name.description: Name recorded on the canonical customer acceptance.

accepted_by_email.description: Email recorded on the canonical customer acceptance.

attachment_refs.description: References to files/photos carried from the opportunity handoff (no binary copies).

tags.description: Comma-separated tags for filtering/search (e.g. 'pylon, rebrand, phase 1').

tax_percent.description: Sales tax % — tax = taxable base × tax%.

discount_percent.description: Project-level discount % applied to the adjusted sections subtotal.

contingency_percent.description: Contingency % applied AFTER discount: contingency = (subtotal − discount) × contingency%.

shipping_fee.description: Flat project-level shipping/freight fee added before tax.

permit_fee.description: Flat project-level permit/admin fee added before tax.

round_quote_total.description: Round the computed quote total to the nearest whole dollar.

quote_valid_days.description: How many days the customer quote stays valid.

quote_issue_date.description: Customer-facing issue date of the currently issued quote version. Updated when the estimate transitions into sent or when an intentional revision is completed while remaining sent; historical sent estimates are not automatically backfilled.

quote_expiration_date.description: Optional per-estimate override of the quote expiration date. When blank, expiry is computed as quote_issue_date + quote_valid_days.

quote_expired.description: Persisted mirror of the computed expiry check (sent past quote_issue_date + quote_valid_days) so expired quotes are reportable by filter without recomputing per row.

quote_valid_until.description: Derived expiry alias read by quote delivery + workspace views (K-10); mirrors quote_expiration_date/computed expiry.

email_signature.description: Per-estimate copy of the QuoteDefaults email signature snapshot for delivery emails (K-10).

default_tax_group.description: TaxGroup name resolved for this estimate when no manual tax pick exists (K-10 chain: manual > customer > defaults > TaxGroup.is_default).

tax_rate_source.description: Which hop of the tax-rate resolution chain this estimate used (K-10).

quote_version.description: Customer-facing quote issue version. Starts at 1 on the first transition into sent and increments on each later transition into sent or completed revision that remains sent. Separate from EstimateRevision.revision_number.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms text shown on the customer quote.

scope_inclusions.description: Newline-separated list of what's INCLUDED — rendered as bullets on the customer quote.

scope_exclusions.description: Newline-separated list of what's EXCLUDED — rendered as bullets on the customer quote.

scope_auto_apply.description: When true, scope library lines flagged always_include, or whose auto_modules match a section on this estimate, are added automatically.

hide_section_prices.description: When true the customer quote shows ONE bundled project price instead of per-section pricing.

section_acceptance_mode.description: When true the customer portal lets the customer accept, decline, or question each quote section individually rather than only approving the whole quote.

company_name.description: Your company name shown in the customer quote header.

company_license.description: License / registration number printed under the company block.

quote_title.description: Headline printed at the top of the quote.

quote_accent_color.description: Hex accent color for the quote header rule and highlight text.

quote_intro_text.description: Optional paragraph printed above the pricing table.

quote_footer_text.description: Optional paragraph printed at the very bottom of the quote.

quote_terms_conditions.description: Terms & conditions block printed on the quote.

warranty_text.description: Warranty statement printed on the quote.

lead_time_text.description: Production / install lead time statement printed on the quote.

show_notes_on_quote.description: When true, estimate-level notes are included on the customer quote. Defaults off because estimate notes may contain internal project context.

round_prices_to_dollar.description: Display-only: rounds every price shown on the customer quote to the nearest dollar.

is_template.description: Marks the estimate as a reusable template — duplicated into new estimates via the New Estimate template picker.

cancel_reason.description: Reason captured when the estimate is cancelled (from the Cancel Estimate modal).

cancelled_at.description: UTC timestamp of the cancellation. The cancelling actor is recorded on the lifecycle EstimateRevision.

archived_at.description: UTC timestamp the estimate was archived.

archived_reason.description: Optional reason for archiving (e.g. lost, superseded, test, merged).

line_items.description: Estimate sections. Totals are refreshed from the source projects whenever the estimate is opened, and in real time while it is open.

line_id.description: Stable id for this estimate product line. Used to link the persistent BuilderProduct record.

builder_product_id.description: Persistent BuilderProduct id for frozen pricing, parts, groups, and full builder snapshots.

builder_name.description: Internal/estimator-facing builder identity or product type.

client_product_name.description: Editable client-facing name for this product; kept distinct from builder_name/project_name.

product_category.description: User-defined Product Category used for estimate organization and customer quote categorization.

production_product_type.description: Optional production/SIP Product Type selected from GlobalSettings.productTypes. Blank means intentionally unclassified.

product_notes.description: Estimator-facing Product notes. Separate from customer_description.

total_snapshot.description: Accepted/frozen UNIT Product cost snapshot. Estimate pricing extends this unit amount by customer_quantity, then applies adjustment_percent. Live inventory changes do not replace it until Update Price is accepted.

live_total_snapshot.description: Most recently detected/recalculated live cost used only for price-change comparison.

price_recalc_required.description: True when Master Inventory changed after this Builder was last calculated and Update Price must wait until the Builder is reopened/saved.

price_recalc_reason.description: Human-readable reason this Product requires Builder recalculation before Update Price.

price_acceptance_pending.description: Durable retry marker for a Builder/Product multi-record mutation such as initial freeze, Update Price, detached-Part changes, Saved Part insertion, or whole Quick Product insertion. Stores the exact recovery target until the final Estimate line write completes.

quick_product_insert_key.description: Stable provenance/idempotency key retained only after a Quick Product or copied Product insertion completes successfully.

quick_product_source_type.description: Origin of a completed reusable Product insertion, such as quick_product or clipboard_product.

quick_product_source_id.description: Source QuickProduct or EstimateClipboardItem id for a completed reusable Product insertion when available.

last_part_group_mutation_key.description: Idempotency receipt for the most recently completed structural Part Group create/dissolve action on this Product.

last_part_group_mutation_kind.description: Kind of the most recently completed structural Part Group action, such as create or dissolve.

blank_product_insert_key.description: Idempotency receipt for a completed blank Builder-backed or Custom Product insertion.

blank_product_insert_kind.description: Completed blank Product insertion type: builder or custom.

adjustment_percent.description: Per-section price adjustment %. Positive = markup, negative = discount. adjusted = total × (1 + adj%/100).

section_status.description: Estimating workflow status of this section.

section_note.description: Internal note about this section (not shown to the customer).

customer_description.description: Customer-facing description shown under the section on the quote.

customer_quantity.description: Product quantity. Estimate pricing extends each Product as total_snapshot × customer_quantity before adjustment_percent; this quantity can also be shown on the customer quote when the quantity column is enabled.

include_in_customer.description: When false, this section's price is bundled into a single 'Additional project scope' quote line instead of being listed.

owned.description: True when this sub-estimate was created BY this All-In-One estimate (a built-in section). Owned sections are deleted together with the section / estimate.

updated_date_snapshot.description: Last-known updated_date of the source sub-estimate.

total_cost.description: Sum of raw section totals (before adjustments/discount/tax).

quote_total.description: Customer-facing quote total after the full pricing waterfall (adjustments, discount, contingency, fees, tax).

internal_approval.description: Manager sign-off recorded when the quote total exceeds the internal approval threshold (GlobalSettings key quote_approval_threshold). Written by the approve_quote action before a quote can be sent.

volume_discount_tiers.description: Snapshot of the linked customer's volume discount tiers captured at customer-select time.

category_adjustments.description: Per-category price adjustments for this estimate only — {'Category': percent} stacked on top of each section's own adjustment_percent.

pricing_tier.description: Markup pricing tier auto-applied from the linked Customer (Customer.pricing_tier).

personal_tags.description: Per-user color/label tags for personal organization — keyed by staff email, e.g. {'brett@cincisigns.com': {'color': 'red'}}. Not customer-visible; each user only sees their own tag.

notes_log.description: Timestamped internal note entries appended over the estimate's life — the single notes field stays the freeform scratch field.

edit_reason.description: Pending lifecycle reason used when a draft/calculated estimate is moved into or out of a protected status. The reason is written to EstimateRevision history and this temporary field is cleared after save.

pipeline_sync_pending.description: True only when the estimate/lifecycle audit saved successfully but synchronization to the shared Customer/Sales Pipeline did not complete. Cleared after a successful retry.

pipeline_sync_error.description: Last downstream Customer/Sales Pipeline synchronization error for a pending retry. Internal recovery metadata; never shown on the customer quote.

last_product_removal_key.description: Idempotency receipt for the most recently completed Estimate Product removal.

last_product_removal_line_id.description: Estimate line id removed by the most recently completed Product removal.

last_product_removal_at.description: Timestamp of the most recently completed Product removal.

entered_by_display.description: Display name of the staff member who entered the order (CoreBridge 'Entered By').

follow_up_state.description: Follow-up state machine snapshot (H-04): {stage: none|fu1_sent|fu2_sent|answered|closed, last_sent_at, next_due_at, anchor_at, fu1_sent_at, fu2_sent_at, answered_at, closed_reason}.

payment_terms_label.description: Payment terms display label printed on documents (e.g. 'Balance Due Upon Receipt'). Complements the payment_terms/terms text fields.

internal_discount.description: Internal (non-customer-facing) discount amount tracked for margin reporting; separate from the customer-facing discount_percent waterfall.

fee_lines.description: Canonical OrderFee lines (shipping, postage, discount, misc fee) carried through order-to-invoice. Each line: {label, kind, amount, taxable, income_account_code}. Mirrored identically on AllInOneEstimate and Invoice.

label.description: Display label for the fee line.

taxable.description: Whether this line is included in the taxable base.

income_account_code.description: GL income account code for accounting export.

EstimateOption.name: EstimateOption
EstimateOption.description: Admin-managed dropdown list values used by the estimate workflow and the customer dialogs. One record per option, grouped by option_type (salesperson, sales_center, terms, customer_origination, industry_type, contact_status, job_authority, master_account, phone_type).

FleetDashboardPreference.name: FleetDashboardPreference
FleetDashboardPreference.description: Per-user Fleet dashboard layout/preferences. Server-managed; users only read their own preference row.

name.description: Template name

is_default.description: Whether this is the default template

PermittingHtmlEvidence.name: PermittingHtmlEvidence
PermittingHtmlEvidence.description: Immutable retained official HTML response bytes and conservative static-text blocks. Manual retention and exact quotes do not establish adopted law or office authority. No PDF pages are manufactured.

name.description: Name of the email group

permission_sections.description: Admin sections granted to group members — members inherit these on top of their own admin_permissions.

emails.description: List of email addresses in this group

module_name.description: The unique identifier for the module.

is_enabled.description: The default enabled state for new users.

Settings.name: Settings
Settings.description: Estimator rate/setting key-value records, grouped by category. Drives the per-module estimator calculations and Settings pages.

description.description: Description of what this setting controls

PermittingSourceDocument.name: PermittingSourceDocument
PermittingSourceDocument.description: Standardized source-evidence record for a single archived permitting document. One record per official source file (adopted code section, application form, fee schedule, checklist, legislative evidence, rewrite draft, etc.). Migrated from JurisdictionProfile.documents[] by linking (originals kept intact); jurisdiction_profile_doc_id references the original document id.

title.description: Human-readable title of the source document.

jurisdiction_name.description: Name of the jurisdiction this source belongs to (e.g. 'Boone County').

jurisdiction_id.description: Canonical JurisdictionProfile record id this source belongs to, when linked.

source_registration_key.description: Durable automatic registration identity: jurisdiction, retained official URL, and verified archive hash. Used to reconcile uncertain creates without duplicates.

jurisdiction_profile_doc_id.description: Original JurisdictionProfile.documents[].id this record was migrated from, so both stay consistent. Blank for sources archived directly into PermittingSourceDocument.

issuing_office.description: Official office that publishes the source (e.g. 'Boone County Planning Commission', 'Boone County Building Department').

office_id.description: PermitLocality.offices[].id this document belongs to — the durable office→file link (resolved by name/host match; blank when unassigned).

official_url.description: Exact official URL the source was retrieved from.

online_form_url.description: Online application/form portal URL when distinct from the official_url.

archived_file_path.description: Repository path to the archived file (e.g. public/permitting/sources/boone-ky/...).

archived_file_url.description: Storage file_url for the archived copy when uploaded to app storage.

file_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the archived file bytes.

file_bytes.description: Byte count of the archived file.

http_outcome.description: HTTP status / outcome of the retrieval (e.g. '200', '404', 'manual').

retrieval_timestamp.description: When the source was retrieved/archived. Distinct from effective_or_adopted_date.

document_revision_date.description: Revision date printed on the document itself, when known.

effective_or_adopted_date.description: Official effective or adopted date of the content. Distinct from retrieval_timestamp.

content_status.description: Whether current adoption is unknown or content is current, historical, draft, proposed, or superseded. Successful retrieval does not establish current authority.

authority_confidence.description: Confidence that this source is the authoritative current source for its subject.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Scope of applicability (e.g. 'unincorporated Boone County', 'Florence Main Street overlay', 'countywide right-of-way').

supersedes.description: Reference to a source document this one supersedes, when verified.

superseded_by.description: Reference to a source document that supersedes this one, when verified.

last_checked.description: When the source was last checked against the official URL for changes.

last_changed.description: When the source content was last observed to have changed at the official URL.

verification_status.description: Human review status. 'gap_recorded' means no official source found and the gap is documented.

reviewer.description: Employee who last verified or reviewed this source.

notes_gaps.description: Explicit gaps, caveats, applicability notes, and supersession relationships.

extracted_text.description: Searchable extracted text from the archived file. For segmented extraction this preserves the initial inline preview; read physical pages through getPermittingSourceTextPages. Check text_extraction_state for scope and completeness.

text_extraction_pinned.description: Preserves staff-maintained text; both manual and automatic extraction must skip it.

text_extraction_state.description: Bounded deterministic text-extraction lease, retry state, page cursor, archive identity, and completeness. Text availability does not establish adopted authority.

extracted_pages.description: Preserved initial physical PDF pages with extracted text, archive hash, parser method, and gaps. Later pages may live in immutable PermittingSourceTextSegment records; the committed cursor is in text_extraction_state. Original archive and review decisions remain intact.

authority_review.description: Version-bound staff review of an administrative source publisher, current-source evidence and explicitly quoted geographic scope. Never establishes adopted law or resolves a job address.

authority_review_state.description: Durable manual authority-review audit create/application receipt. Unknown creates reconcile without repeated writes.

rule_import_state.description: Source-wide candidate import reservation across all manual analysis runs. Uncertain creates retain their extraction key until reconciled; a fresh run cannot bypass the create intent.

rule_extraction_state.description: Manual selected-page rule extraction reservation and durable run identity. Independent of text/archive workers; unknown creates and LLM attempts are reconciled, never blindly repeated.

derived_facts.description: Structured facts derived from the source (fee amounts, permit exemptions, etc.).

authority_classification.description: Deterministic authority classification produced by the source classifier. Draft/comprehensive_rewrite classifications trigger rewrite protection via the authority gate.

matched_signals.description: Deterministic signals/evidence that led to the authority_classification.

classified_at.description: When the authority_classification was computed and persisted.

ocr_evidence.description: Bounded append-only administrator-supplied OCR evidence. Each receipt is tied to verified PDF bytes and physical page, retained unreviewed, with method and content integrity hashes. Kept separate from extracted_text/pages and all authority reviews. Read through permittingSourceOcrEvidence; never substitute into approved regulations automatically.

ocr_transcriptions.description: Append-only through the evidence handler: visual transcription candidates bound to a retained OCR record, archive hash, physical page and normalized excerpt regions. Always pending staff review. Original OCR and regulatory/source approvals remain unchanged.

FileBridgeRecent.name: FileBridgeRecent
FileBridgeRecent.description: Recent-changes ring (~2000 rows) — 'recently changed in customer folders' feed without churning FileIndex. TTL-swept.

FleetInspectionTemplate.name: FleetInspectionTemplate
FleetInspectionTemplate.description: Reusable CCS Fleet inspection/checklist template. Fleet-only and separate from signage workflows.

CustomerNote.name: CustomerNote
CustomerNote.description: A note or a flag attached to a Customer. Notes are internal history entries; flags are short warnings shown on the customer header and on estimates for that customer (e.g. 'Credit hold', 'Prepay only').

flag_color.description: Badge color used when kind = flag.

VinylProject.name: VinylProject
VinylProject.description: A Vinyl Estimator project. Holds vinyl graphics items (size, qty, vinyl/laminate selection, print flag, labor), the project rates, and the rolled-up totals.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

customer_pricing.description: Saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Preserves selected tier, category breakdown, volume discount and final customer price without changing internal Builder cost.

FleetCutoverState.name: FleetCutoverState
FleetCutoverState.description: Server-owned Fleet cutover guard state. Normal clients may read as admin but cannot create/update/delete; fleetCutoverControl writes through service role.

case_key.description: Stable backend case key for one punch exception on one TimeEntry

user_email.description: Employee who owns the affected TimeEntry

status.description: Punch exception lifecycle state

detected_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when the exception was first recorded

detected_clock_in.description: Original clock-in observed when the exception was detected

original_snapshot.description: Immutable TimeEntry snapshot captured when the exception was created

employee_response.description: Employee attestation supplied during self-service recovery

claimed_clock_out.description: Employee-attested prior shift end time; not a server punch and requires manager review

claimed_clock_in.description: Employee-attested missing Clock In time used to reconstruct an otherwise absent shift; always marked Needs Review

submitted_at.description: Trusted backend timestamp when the employee submitted the response

request_id.description: Idempotency request id for the latest employee exception response

correction_request_id.description: TimeClockCorrectionRequest created for a missed clock-out response

resolution_audit_id.description: TimeClockAudit record confirming the exception response

acknowledged_until.description: For worked-through responses, backend time until another stale-shift prompt may appear

GeneralTask.name: GeneralTask
GeneralTask.description: General office task not tied to a client or work order. Mirrors the task object shape used inside WorkOrder.notes so it can be assigned and tracked the same way. When `stage` is set, the task also appears on the matching workflow stage page (Estimating, Design, etc.).

stage.description: Workflow stage this task is assigned to, so it surfaces on that workflow page. Empty means a general office task not tied to a stage page.

assigned_to.description: Users assigned to this task (full_name or email, matching WorkOrder task assignment convention).

sub_tasks.description: Sub-tasks under this task, same structure as WorkOrder note sub_tasks.

blocked.description: Task is blocked and cannot proceed until unblocked

created_by_name.description: Display name of the user who created the task

FleetMaintenanceTask.name: FleetMaintenanceTask
FleetMaintenanceTask.description: Fleet maintenance schedule/task. Completely separate from the Sign Maintenance estimator.

generation_key.description: Deterministic key/receipt for retry-safe scheduled work-order generation.

creation_key.description: Stable client-generated idempotency key for a logical Fleet maintenance schedule create operation.

TaxGroup.name: TaxGroup
TaxGroup.description: Sales tax group selectable on an estimate (e.g. 'Ohio - Hamilton County (7.8%)'). Picking a tax group sets the estimate's tax_percent, which the All-In-One pricing waterfall multiplies by the taxable base. Admin-managed on the Estimate Settings page.

agency_id.description: Optional reference to a TaxAgency record — the taxing authority this group's collected tax is remitted/reported to.

_CheckpointMistake.name: _CheckpointMistake
_CheckpointMistake.description: DO NOT CREATE — placeholder entity used only for checkpoint markers. Not a real data entity.

EstimateClipboardItem.name: EstimateClipboardItem
EstimateClipboardItem.description: Database-backed 30-day estimator clipboard. Stores portable Product, Part Group or Part snapshots with source estimate/order/company metadata. Pasting creates new estimate/Product/Part snapshots and never mutates the source.

idempotency_key.description: Stable copy receipt used to converge retries of the same clipboard copy without creating duplicates.

payload.description: Portable lossless snapshot. Product payloads use the same v2 package as Quick Products; group/part payloads preserve complete BuilderPart snapshots.

QuoteScopeLine.name: QuoteScopeLine
QuoteScopeLine.description: Reusable library line for the customer quote's scope lists. kind = 'inclusion' (Included in this estimate) or 'exclusion' (Not included). Selected from the Scope dropdowns in Quote Settings. When always_include is true the line is auto-added to every quote; when auto_modules lists estimator module keys, the line is auto-added as soon as a section of that module exists on the estimate.

text.description: The scope line exactly as it prints on the quote.

category.description: Grouping label shown in the scope dropdown (e.g. Fabrication, Install, Permits, Electrical, Warranty).

always_include.description: Auto-added to every quote regardless of which products are on the estimate.

auto_modules.description: Estimator module keys that trigger this line automatically when a section of that module is added.

Customer.name: Customer
Customer.description: Shared Client record for the whole app. Used by the estimator (Step 1 of the estimate workflow, Customers area) AND by the workflow side — WorkOrders and Orders link to it via customer_id, so estimates, work orders and material orders all hang off the same client.

estimator_creation_key.description: Internal receipt used only to converge simultaneous creation of the same new Customer from Estimate Step 1. Historical Customers are never assigned or merged by this field.

creation_request_key.description: Internal random receipt for retry-safe explicit New Customer creation. It is not derived from company name, so separate intentional Customer records remain possible.

last_contacted_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent real customer contact (quote sent, portal message).

merged_into_customer_id.description: Set when this Customer was merged into another canonical Customer — linked records were relinked and this row is kept for audit.

merged_at.description: UTC timestamp when this Customer was merged (tombstoned) into merged_into_customer_id. Written by manageCustomerLifecycle merge_customers (G-14).

merged_by.description: Staff email/id who performed the customer merge.

merge_run.description: Durable merge progress for an in-flight/partial merge_customers run: {run_key, keep_id, status, started_at, updated_at, finished_at, actor, entities{<Entity>: {status, scanned, relinked, skipped, failed_count, failures[]}}}. A run_key matching a retried call resumes instead of restarting (G-14 D6).

customer_status.description: Account status shown in the customer header.

status.description: CRM lifecycle status string — Lead | Prospect | Active | Inactive (CoreBridge 'Status'). Parallel to the legacy customer_status enum; kept as a free string for import fidelity.

customer_type.description: Customer classification (CoreBridge 'Customer Type', e.g. retail, wholesale, contractor).

warning_flags.description: Warning flags raised on this account (e.g. credit_hold, do_not_mail, tax_expired) — surfaced as badges on customer views.

warning_flag_details.description: Per-flag audit sidecar (G-11): {flag: {note, set_by, set_at}} written by customerWarningModel.setFlagPatch — keeps warning_flags[] a clean string list while persisting badge detail.

tags.description: Freeform customer labels (e.g. wholesale, repeat, VIP) — filterable on the customer list.

additional_contacts.description: Extra people at this customer, managed on the Contacts tab.

salesperson.description: Screen name of the user assigned to this account.

location.description: Sales center / location this customer belongs to.

quote_valid_days.description: Per-customer quote validity window in days (overrides the estimate default of 30 when set).

origination_path.description: Hierarchical origination path (CoreBridge 'Origination', e.g. "Networking Group : BNI - Carl - Tier 1"). Complements the flat customer_origination label.

master_account_id.description: Customer id of the master/parent account this record rolls up to (CoreBridge 'Master Account' link). master_account holds the display label.

credit_terms_days.description: Net credit terms in days for invoicing (e.g. 30 = Net 30). Complements the free-text terms field.

tax_exempt.description: Legacy tax-exempt flag (CoreBridge 'Tax Exempt'). The canonical exemption registry record is tax_exemption; this boolean stays for import fidelity and is read as a legacy alias by taxExemptModel.

tax_exempt_id.description: Tax-exempt certificate / exemption id number (CoreBridge 'Tax Exempt ID'). Complements tax_id_number.

tax_exempt_expires.description: Tax-exempt certificate expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Complements tax_exempt_expiration.

tax_exemption.description: Canonical tax-exemption registry record for this customer. The flat tax_exempt*/tax_id_number fields above are legacy import aliases — taxExemptModel normalizes object-first, then flats. A blank expires_on means the certificate does not auto-expire (perpetual).

certificate_id.description: Exemption certificate / permit number on file.

expires_on.description: Certificate expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Blank = no auto-expire.

issued_by.description: Issuing authority (e.g. state / agency that granted the certificate).

status.description: Registry status. 'revoked' always wins; 'expired' is also derived automatically from expires_on.

po_required.description: When true, orders for this customer require a purchase order number (CoreBridge 'PO Required'). Parallel to require_purchase_order.

po_required_note.description: Free-text detail about this customer's PO requirement (e.g. "PO required on all orders") — surfaced to estimators when the PO gate blocks quote send or approval.

credit_hold.description: When true, new estimates warn that the customer is on credit hold — a visible badge on the new-estimate and detail views.

in_store_credit.description: Unapplied in-store credit balance owed to this customer (CoreBridge 'In-Store Credit'). Distinct from credit_limit, which caps open account charges.

in_store_credit_balance.description: Current in-store credit balance owed to this customer (CoreBridge 'In-Store Credit' balance). Parallel to in_store_credit.

pricing_tier.description: Overall markup pricing tier applied to this customer's estimates.

pricing_tier_set_by.description: Staff user/email who last assigned the pricing tier (F-22 audit).

pricing_tier_set_at.description: When the pricing tier was last assigned (F-22 audit).

auto_inactive_after_months.description: Months without activity after which this customer auto-marks inactive (CoreBridge 'auto-inactive'). 0 falls through to the shop default — per-customer opt-out is auto_inactive_disabled, NOT zero (N-07.3).

auto_inactive_months.description: Months without activity before this customer auto-marks inactive (CoreBridge 'Auto Inactive' months). 0 falls through to the shop default — opt-out is auto_inactive_disabled. Parallel to auto_inactive_after_months.

auto_inactive_disabled.description: Per-customer opt-out of the auto-inactive sweep. Set true to exempt this customer regardless of month thresholds.

lifecycle_status.description: Denormalized lifecycle status mirror written by manageCustomerLifecycle (lead/prospect/active/inactive + merged). Declared for schema completeness — previously stored undeclared (N-07).

tax_exempt_issued_by.description: Legacy flat alias: issuer of the tax-exempt certificate. Read by taxExemptModel after the tax_exemption object.

tax_exempt_status.description: Legacy flat alias: exemption status (active|expired|revoked). Read by taxExemptModel after tax_exemption.status.

tax_exempt_revoked.description: Legacy flat alias: certificate revoked flag. Read by taxExemptModel alongside tax_exemption.revoked.

legacy_client_names.description: Workflow client_name strings reconciled into this Customer record, used to match existing WorkOrders and Orders.

FleetRepairApprovalPolicyCreateGate.name: FleetRepairApprovalPolicyCreateGate
FleetRepairApprovalPolicyCreateGate.description: Backend-only singleton CAS coordinator for Fleet repair approval policy creation. Exactly one scope row must be provisioned before policy creation is enabled.

status.description: Backend-only create gate state.

EstimateAcceptance.name: EstimateAcceptance
EstimateAcceptance.description: Immutable audit record that a customer accepted a specific issued customer quote version. This records the acceptance evidence/method; EstimateRevision continues to record the resulting whole-estimate lifecycle transition to approved.

delivery_id.description: Optional exact EstimateQuoteDelivery record the customer accepted; blank when acceptance is not tied to a specific delivery.

quote_issue_key.description: Stable identity shared with the issued quote version, its deliveries, and related EstimateRevision records.

quote_expiration_date.description: Valid-through date of the customer quote version that was accepted.

quote_total.description: Customer quote total accepted; never internal cost.

evidence_reference.description: Short reference to the evidence, such as signed quote received, customer email, PO, or conversation reference.

recorded_by_email.description: Internal staff email that recorded the acceptance through the authenticated acceptance service.

recorded_by_name.description: Internal staff display name that recorded the acceptance.

status.description: Lifecycle of this acceptance row. Rows default to 'accepted'; a staff 'Supersede acceptance' action marks the row 'superseded', after which it no longer counts as the canonical approval for its quote version but stays in the audit history.

superseded_at.description: UTC timestamp the acceptance was superseded by staff.

superseded_by_email.description: Staff email that superseded the acceptance.

superseded_by_name.description: Staff display name that superseded the acceptance.

supersede_reason.description: Reason recorded when the acceptance was superseded.

BouncieOAuthState.name: BouncieOAuthState
BouncieOAuthState.description: Short-lived, one-time-use OAuth state values for the Bouncie authorization code flow. Created when an admin starts the connect flow and consumed by the callback.

state.description: Cryptographically random state value sent to Bouncie.

redirect_uri.description: Exact redirect_uri used in the authorization request.

initiated_by.description: Email of the admin who started the flow.

expires_at.description: State expiry — callbacks after this time are rejected.

used.description: True once consumed; a second callback with the same state is rejected.

FleetPartIdentification.name: FleetPartIdentification
FleetPartIdentification.description: Fleet-only AI/manual part-identification inbox. Stores reviewable lookup evidence and candidate data before anything is promoted into FleetPart inventory.

duplicate_part_ids.description: Potential existing FleetPart matches requiring review.

suggested_equipment_ids.description: Review-only compatibility suggestions; never authoritative until a user confirms them.

creation_key.description: Stable idempotency key for one identify/organize session.

user_email.description: Email of the employee

status.description: Request status

archived_test_data.description: Pre-production Time Clock test request excluded from live timekeeping

archived_at.description: When pre-production test data was reset/archived

last_request_id.description: Last authoritative Time Clock request id that created or edited this request

last_request_payload_hash.description: Payload hash bound to the last authoritative Time Clock request

FleetRepairEstimate.name: FleetRepairEstimate
FleetRepairEstimate.description: Fleet-only repair estimate and approval record linked to FleetMaintenanceWorkOrder. Financial planning is kept separate from the work-order execution record.

user_email.description: Email of user running the import

status.description: Current import status

file_hash.description: Canonical spreadsheet content fingerprint used to detect exact repeat imports.

phase.description: Current importer phase such as validating, matching, applying, or verifying.

duration_ms.description: Total server processing time in milliseconds.

parse_ms.description: Spreadsheet parsing and validation time in milliseconds.

match_ms.description: WorkOrder preload, identity matching, and change-plan time in milliseconds.

apply_ms.description: WorkOrder write and verification time in milliseconds.

OpportunityActivity.name: OpportunityActivity
OpportunityActivity.description: Append-only audit log for an Opportunity: stage transitions, field edits, links, estimating handoffs, and reconciliation advances — written by opportunityWorkspaceAction via service role. Also carries typed CRM contact events (calls, e-mails, visits, consultations) created from the CRM Events queue: those rows use the CoreBridge-style event_type taxonomy values plus subject/due_at/assigned_to/outcome fields, are written through the staffEntityWrite gateway, and may omit opportunity_id.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one activity entry.

opportunity_id.description: Linked Opportunity for audit rows. Optional for standalone CRM events (prospecting calls, customer follow-ups) that have no pursuit yet.

event_type_id.description: FK to CrmEventType — the typed taxonomy row backing event_type for CRM queue events.

subject.description: CRM event subject line (CoreBridge 'Event Name'). Falls back to the event_type label in the queue when blank.

contact_name.description: Display name of the person this CRM event touches.

company_name.description: Display company/customer name for queue rendering.

customer_id.description: Canonical Customer id when resolved — deep-links the queue row to the customer record.

work_order_id.description: Linked WorkOrder when the CRM event concerns an active job.

assigned_to.description: Staff user (email or screen name) responsible for this CRM event — the queue's salesperson filter.

due_at.description: ISO timestamp the CRM event is due; overdue rows sort first in the queue.

completed_at.description: ISO timestamp the CRM event was marked complete. Blank while open.

completed_by.description: Staff user (email or screen name) who marked the CRM event complete. Blank while open.

outcome.description: Close-out result for a completed CRM event (completed, cancelled, no_answer, left_message, rescheduled).

source.description: How the CRM event was created — manual queue entry, automated follow-up generation, or system.

ChannelLetterInstallEquipment.name: ChannelLetterInstallEquipment
ChannelLetterInstallEquipment.description: Install equipment catalog (lifts, boom trucks, ladders, vehicles) with reach geometry, owned/rented pricing and idle-running costs. Shared by the Channel Letters, Foundation and Sign Maintenance estimators via the show_in_* flags.

ownership.description: Whether the equipment is owned by the shop or rented.

is_default_for_height.description: When true, this boom lift / boom truck is the default pick when an install falls inside its height range.

is_primary_owned.description: Marks your go-to OWNED lift for normal use. The equipment suggester picks this lift first for any job it can reach, only stepping up to a taller/rented lift when the install height exceeds its reach.

default_height_min_feet.description: Bottom of the install-height range this boom is the default for (inclusive).

default_height_max_feet.description: Top of the install-height range this boom is the default for (inclusive).

idle_running_cost_per_hour.description: Per-hour cost of running the boom/truck idle on-site (fuel + wear). Charged in addition to rental/flat rate.

show_in_channel_letters.description: Show this equipment in the Channel & Dimensional Letters estimator.

show_in_foundation.description: Show this equipment in the Concrete | Masonry | Poles estimator.

show_in_sign_maintenance.description: Show this equipment in the Sign Maintenance estimator.

SignPartsSuppliesInventory.name: SignPartsSuppliesInventory
SignPartsSuppliesInventory.description: Sign-specific finished parts and shop supplies that don't fit substrates, hardware, lighting, vinyl, or equipment: trim cap, returns, retainers, J-bar, raceway covers, edge trim, paint/inks, adhesives/sealants, blades, cleaners, abrasives, tapes, gloves, etc.

size.description: Free-form size descriptor (e.g. '3/4" black trim cap', 'quart', '1 gallon').

LegacyMigrationMap.name: LegacyMigrationMap
LegacyMigrationMap.description: Internal audit map for one-time legacy SignEstimate Pro migrations. Keeps source record IDs mapped to their CCS record IDs so migrations can be resumed safely without creating duplicates.

ProjectTemplate.name: ProjectTemplate
ProjectTemplate.description: Reusable snapshot of an estimator project used as a starting template for new estimates.

idempotency_key.description: Internal random receipt used to make one Save Template action retry-safe without merging separate intentional templates.

BouncieVehicleLiveState.name: BouncieVehicleLiveState
BouncieVehicleLiveState.description: Bounded live driving state for one vehicle, maintained from Bouncie tripStart/tripData/tripEnd webhooks. One record per vehicle (keyed by IMEI/VIN). Historical trips come from the Bouncie REST trip endpoint, not from here.

transaction_id.description: Bouncie transactionId of the trip currently in progress.

recent_path_points.description: Bounded ring buffer of recent GPS points for the active trip (most recent last, capped server-side).

user_email.description: User's email

policy_id.description: ID of the PTO policy assigned

hire_date.description: Employee hire date for anniversary calculations

balances.description: Current balance for each time off type

last_request_id.description: Last authoritative PTO balance assignment request id

last_request_payload_hash.description: Payload hash bound to the last authoritative PTO balance assignment

FleetEquipment.name: FleetEquipment
FleetEquipment.description: Fleet maintenance/asset identity for road vehicles and non-road equipment. Separate from Bouncie tracking and estimator equipment inventories.

serial_number.description: Original VIN or serial number exactly as migrated from FleetMaster.

vin.description: Normalized VIN used for Bouncie linking when applicable.

creation_key.description: Stable client-generated idempotency key for a logical Fleet equipment create operation.

MaintenanceEquipment.name: MaintenanceEquipment
MaintenanceEquipment.description: Lifts, boom trucks, ladders, vehicles and tools available to the Sign Maintenance / Installation estimators, with rental or owned pricing, reach geometry and idle-running costs.

FileBridgeChunk.name: FileBridgeChunk
FileBridgeChunk.description: In-flight chunk reassembly for >48MB deliveries. Rows expire quickly — TTL-swept.

CustomItemsProject.name: CustomItemsProject
CustomItemsProject.description: Custom line-items estimate section — a flat list of hand-entered or CSV-imported priced items (no module-specific geometry). extractManualItems reads `items` for its `custom_items` module key.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

items.description: Flat priced line items — {description, quantity, item_total_cost, item_type}. Feeds extractManualItems for the custom_items module.

item_total_cost.description: Extended cost for this line (qty * unit cost).

total_cost.description: Section grand total — sum of items[].item_total_cost.

pricing_engine.description: F-23j: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge, items: {<idx-key|index>: line descriptor}}. user_email.description: Employee email these Time Clock preferences belong to

tracker_enabled.description: Show the Time Tracker pill in the app navigation bars

daily_goal_minutes.description: Daily paid-time goal in minutes (default 8 hours)

weekly_goal_minutes.description: Weekly paid-time goal in minutes (default 40 hours)

show_week_strip.description: Show the Mon-Sun weekly progress strip in the tracker popover

count_mode.description: paid = worked time only; elapsed = wall-clock since Clock In

direction.description: up = count up elapsed; down = count down remaining to goal

milestone_thresholds.description: Custom milestone thresholds as fractions of the daily goal (0-1.5)

overtime_warning.description: Fire a milestone alert when paid time passes the daily goal

show_overtime.description: Show +M:MM OT counter once past the daily goal

privacy_blur.description: Blur tracker values until the control is hovered or focused

location.description: Which navigation bars render the tracker pill

scale.description: Render scale of the tracker pill (0.8-1.3)

hide_when_idle_minutes.description: Hide the tracker after this many minutes of mouse/keyboard inactivity (0 = never hide)

daily_goal_overrides.description: Optional per-day-of-week goal overrides in minutes, keyed sun-sat; missing days use daily_goal_minutes

low_data_mode.description: Reduce polling frequency and skip secondary fetches on metered connections

last_request_id.description: Idempotency request id of the most recent preference update

FileBridgeEvent.name: FileBridgeEvent
FileBridgeEvent.description: Audit log — every mutation, auth event, failover, error. 'audit EVERYTHING' requirement. TTL-swept (e.g. 90d).

event_type.description: e.g. command_enqueued, upload_applied, delete_tombstoned, auth_failed, role_change, restore.

FleetRepairEstimateCreateGate.name: FleetRepairEstimateCreateGate
FleetRepairEstimateCreateGate.description: Backend-only singleton CAS coordinator for first-time Fleet repair estimate creation across CCS admin and mechanic portal flows. Exactly one scope row must be provisioned before estimate creation is enabled.

status.description: Backend-only create gate state.

FleetMechanicAccess.description: Server-owned revocable bearer-link access for the standalone external Fleet mechanic portal. Raw access tokens are never stored; only SHA-256 hashes are persisted.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw mechanic bearer token. Raw token is shown only when generated and is never persisted.

scope_mode.description: Limits which active Fleet maintenance work orders this bearer link may view. Missing/legacy values are treated as all_active for backward compatibility.

allowed_equipment_ids.description: FleetEquipment ids allowed when scope_mode is selected_equipment.
