VinylPartTemplate.description: Saved/favorited vinyl part definition. Users can save common part sizes (e.g. '12x12 cooler decal') and re-add them with one click.

name.description: Friendly label shown in the parts library picker.

PermittingSourceAuthorityReview.name: PermittingSourceAuthorityReview
PermittingSourceAuthorityReview.description: Immutable manual source/office/scope review intent. A matching source receipt proves application; retained audit intents do not alone establish authority.

TrainingItem.name: TrainingItem
TrainingItem.description: Reusable training material an admin can assign to employees: an SOP in this app, an external video/document link, an uploaded file, a certification, or a custom/in-person item.

title.description: Training name shown on My Workflow and the SOP page.

type.description: sop = links into the /sop module; certification carries an expiry/renewal window.

sop_id.description: Sop record id when type=sop — the My Workflow row deep-links to it.

valid_months.description: For certifications: months the completion stays valid before renewal is due. 0 = no expiry.

active.description: Inactive items can't be newly assigned but keep history.

creation_request_key.description: Deterministic create key for retry/lost-response dedupe.

BuilderPartGroup.name: BuilderPartGroup
BuilderPartGroup.description: A named, ordered group of Builder Parts inside one Builder Product. Groups can be collapsed and copied/moved as a single unit while retaining every child part.

group_key.description: Stable client-generated key used while editing/copying before/after persistence.

client_label.description: Optional customer-facing label distinct from the internal group name.

parent_group_id.description: Optional parent for future nested grouping.

copy_as_unit.description: When true copy/move actions operate on the group and all child parts together.

group_snapshot.description: Lossless group-level builder metadata/settings when a module has group-specific configuration.

FleetAlertRuntimeState.name: FleetAlertRuntimeState
FleetAlertRuntimeState.description: Server-owned runtime state for CCS-local Fleet alert thresholds. Tracks per-vehicle breach/clear transitions so scheduled evaluation is durable and does not spam repeated alerts while a condition remains active.

FleetSettings.name: FleetSettings
FleetSettings.description: Fleet-only administration and notification settings. Never used by estimator Settings. Admin-restricted; no migrated frontend password.

maintenance_generation_enabled.description: Master cutover switch for CCS automatic Fleet maintenance work-order generation.

notifications_enabled.description: Master switch for Fleet operational notification emails.

scheduled_reminders_enabled.description: Master switch for daily Fleet reminder digests.

public_reporting_enabled.description: Master switch for anonymous Fleet issue reporting endpoint.

fleet_app_base_url.description: Optional CCS Fleet base URL used in notification links after cutover.

source_freeze_confirmed.description: Cutover guard. True only after FleetMaster writes/automations have been intentionally frozen and a final source delta check is complete.

mechanic_access_links.description: Server-managed standalone Fleet mechanic portal access grants. Raw bearer tokens are never persisted; each entry stores only token_hash plus display/revocation metadata.

discovery_scan_state.description: Retained exact direct-document referrals and checked-page provenance for owner-scoped external archival.

discovery_last_scan.description: Latest manual page results and resource links, separate from saved-file receipts.

SignageFact.name: SignageFact
SignageFact.description: Structured signage-relevant fact extracted from an official jurisdiction source document. Every fact carries its evidence quote, source document, page, and confidence tier — displayed in-app as fact cards and returned by the signage ask-box. Facts are extracted locally (pattern + Devin-agent passes) and advance through the confidence ladder: pattern → agent → ai_verified → verified.

jurisdiction_name.description: Exact jurisdiction this fact applies to (e.g. 'Boone County', 'City of Florence', 'West Chester Township'). Never merged across jurisdictions.

sign_type.description: Sign-type enum from signage-facts.mjs (wall, monument, emc_digital, temporary, …). 'general' for jurisdiction-wide rules not tied to one type.

fact_key.description: Taxonomy fact key (max_height, permit_required, permit_fee, allowed_zones, …).

value_json.description: Structured value: {value, unit, condition} — e.g. {value:25,unit:'ft',condition:'in C-2 zones'} or {value:false} for prohibitions.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim source text the fact was extracted from.

source_document_id.description: PermittingSourceDocument id the evidence came from.

source_sha256.description: Archive hash of the source file — supersession trigger on re-fetch.

page_ref.description: Page number within the source document.

official_url.description: Retained official URL — the 'pulled from' quick link.

confidence.description: pattern | agent | ai_verified | verified — the display ladder; ai_verified means the local Devin-agent gate cleared it.

ai_gate.description: Local AI review record: {verdict:'pass'|'flag', checked_at, note}.

active.description: false when superseded by a newer source scan.

superseded_by_id.description: SignageFact id that replaced this row.

scope.description: Exactly one backend-provisioned company coordinator. Missing/duplicate rows block manager corrections.

status.description: Backend-only company-wide manager correction CAS status.

CrmEventType.name: CrmEventType
CrmEventType.description: Typed CRM event taxonomy registry (CoreBridge-style): each row is one selectable event type in the CRM Events queue — a channel bucket (call, email, visit, consultation, redo) plus a display label (e.g. 'Estimate Follow Up'). Seeded from the CoreBridge default taxonomy (scripts/crm-event-type-seed.json); types staff add later carry is_custom=true. Backend-only — read/written via service-role functions.

channel.description: Channel bucket the event type belongs to.

label.description: Display label shown in the CRM Events queue picker (e.g. 'Estimate Follow Up').

sort.description: Display ordering of this type in the picker.

is_custom.description: false for CoreBridge-seeded types; true for staff-added types.

status.description: Lifecycle state — active | archived.

PermittingRuleExtractionRun.name: PermittingRuleExtractionRun
PermittingRuleExtractionRun.description: Durable manual selected-page extraction receipt. Staged literal candidates remain non-operational until imported individually and staff reviewed. No automatic LLM retry.

FleetMaintenanceMeterRule.name: FleetMaintenanceMeterRule
FleetMaintenanceMeterRule.description: Fleet maintenance trigger rule based on odometer mileage or engine/equipment hours. Supplements FleetMaintenanceTask without replacing date recurrence.

Responsibility.name: Responsibility
Responsibility.description: Registry of responsibility assignments for products (CoreBridge-style department/person/group). Products carry the chosen label on products[].responsibility plus a denormalized products[].responsibility_color snapshot taken at assignment; registry rows define the managed picklist — label, kind, chip color, member roster, and queue group-header ordering. Backend-only — read/written via service-role functions.

name.description: Responsibility label as stored on products[].responsibility (e.g. 'Design Dept', 'Install Crew A').

type.description: What the label refers to — a department, a single person, or an ad-hoc group.

color.description: Hex display color for the responsibility chip; copied to products[].responsibility_color on assignment.

member_emails.description: Staff emails belonging to this department/group; empty for person rows or unmanaged labels.

sort.description: Display ordering in pickers and queue group headers.

status.description: Lifecycle state — active | archived.

category_key.description: Stable key used by MarkupTier.markups and the categorization library.

category_name.description: Display label, e.g. 'Outsourced Fabrication and Sign Components'.

volume_discount_eligible.description: When false, this category is excluded from volume discounts even if listed in the global eligible-keys setting.

gl_code.description: General ledger income account code this category posts to on accounting export (CoreBridge-style Manage Accounts mapping).

gl_parent.description: Optional parent GL account code/grouping for rollup reporting.

gl_active.description: When false, this category's GL mapping is inactive and exports should flag its lines for review.

user_email.description: Employee email that owns this labor segment

time_entry_id.description: Authoritative TimeEntry this labor segment belongs to

work_order_id.description: Optional referenced WorkOrder id; WorkOrder itself is not modified

duration_minutes.description: Completed labor duration in whole minutes

SaveColor.name: SaveColor
SaveColor.description: A user-saved color swatch reused across estimator modules.

BouncieNotification.name: BouncieNotification
BouncieNotification.description: Fleet notifications derived from Bouncie webhooks and vehicle stats (MIL/check-engine, battery, fuel, device connect/disconnect, trips, geo-zones) plus CCS-generated local alerts. Visible to all app users; only admins delete.

vehicle_vin.description: VIN of the vehicle this notification relates to.

vehicle_imei.description: Bouncie device IMEI for the vehicle.

vehicle_nickname.description: Vehicle nickname at the time the notification was generated.

category.description: Bouncie notification category: drive (trips/fuel/speed/geo-zones), vehicle (battery/device), care (MIL/engine).

event_type.description: Underlying Bouncie event type: mil, battery, fuel, connect, disconnect, tripStart, tripEnd, tripMetrics, userGeozone, applicationGeozone, vinChange, or a CCS rule key.

source.description: 'bouncie' = raw event reported by Bouncie. 'ccs' = alert generated by a CCS-local fleet alert rule.

event_key.description: Deterministic key used to suppress duplicate webhook deliveries of the same event.

title.description: Short headline shown in the notification list.

description.description: Longer detail text (e.g. DTC code + name, or disconnect duration).

raw_data.description: Original webhook payload or vehicle stat snapshot.

name.description: Name of this notification rule

days_before_due.description: Days before due date for due_date_approaching

is_asap.description: Only trigger for ASAP work orders

priority.description: Order of execution if multiple rules match

OriginationNode.name: OriginationNode
OriginationNode.description: Hierarchical origination taxonomy tree (CoreBridge 'Origination' picker): each row is one node in a parent/child tree — e.g. root 'Networking Group' -> child 'BNI - Carl' -> leaf 'Tier 1'. Customer.origination_path stores the denormalized 'Root : Child : Leaf' string; this entity is the canonical tree the picker is built from and the string is resolved against. Backend-only — read/written via service-role functions.

name.description: Display label for this node — a single path segment (e.g. 'BNI - Carl'), never a full path.

parent_id.description: Parent OriginationNode id; empty string marks a root node.

sort.description: Display ordering among siblings in the picker.

status.description: Lifecycle state — active | archived.

full_path.description: Denormalized 'Root : Child : Leaf' path to this node, kept in sync on writes so reports can group/filter without walking the tree.

requester_email.description: Email of the user requesting access.

proposer_email.description: Admin who proposed the grant on someone's behalf — full_admin/breakglass approvals must come from a DIFFERENT admin.

requested_sections.description: Admin sections requested — empty means full admin.

PortalMessage.name: PortalMessage
PortalMessage.description: Two-way customer portal thread. Messages flow customer<->staff per customer account; kind distinguishes plain messages from structured events (estimate approval, revision request, payment notice). Backend-only; written through customerPortalAction.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one message.

VinylWorkflowTemplate.name: VinylWorkflowTemplate
VinylWorkflowTemplate.description: Saved workflow recipe (vinyl + laminate + machine combo) the user can apply to a fresh workflow in one click.

name.description: e.g. '3M IJ180 + 8508 on HP360+Graphtec'

color_tag.description: Hex color for the workflow header pill

FleetFluid.name: FleetFluid
FleetFluid.description: Fleet-specific fluids inventory. Separate from all signage/master/estimator inventories.

fluid_type.description: Canonical or historical Fleet fluid type. Historical blank/legacy values are preserved exactly during migration; the future UI should offer canonical choices for new records.

quantity.description: Current stock quantity in unit. Legacy missing values remain unset during migration.

created_from_request_id.description: FleetPartFluidRequest id that created this inventory row, when applicable.

receive_receipt_key.description: Deterministic receive receipt key used to prevent duplicate inventory creation on retries.

creation_key.description: Stable client-generated idempotency key for a logical Fleet fluid create operation.

FleetInspection.name: FleetInspection
FleetInspection.description: Completed or in-progress Fleet equipment inspection/checklist record with evidence and guarded Fleet work-order follow-up.

FileBridgeHealth.name: FileBridgeHealth
FileBridgeHealth.description: One row per agent — heartbeat, role, index stats, spool depth, drift. Read-failover decisions use last_seen_ms vs 90s window.

agent_id.description: Stable agent identity (env AGENT_ID or minted).

setting_value.description: The setting value as JSON object

hoursOfOperation.description: Two clocks for deadline vs follow-up math (sales center vs production)

sales_center_hours.description: Sales center operating-hours entries (e.g. per-day open/close windows) used for follow-up math

production_hours.description: Production shop operating-hours entries used for deadline math

enabled.description: Master switch for outbound email delivery

from_salesperson_toggle.description: Allow sending from the salesperson's address

recalc_on_proof_approval.description: Recalculate deadlines when a proof is approved

respect_hard_dates.description: Never move dates flagged as hard deadlines

creditTermsDefaults.description: Default credit terms for new customer accounts

autoInactiveMonths.description: Months without activity before a record is auto-marked inactive

pricing_variables.description: Global pricing-formula variable registry (F-07). Custom variables usable in pricing formulas alongside the builtins (Quantity, Width, Height, Depth, PartBaseCost, PartRetail, StitchCount); normalized via shared/pricingVariables.normalizePricingVariables.

name.description: Formula identifier — must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and must not collide with a builtin name or formula literal (case-insensitive)

label.description: Operator-facing label shown in pricing admin

description.description: What the variable feeds / where it is used

default_value.description: Numeric fallback injected into the formula env when no explicit override supplies a value

status.description: Lifecycle status ('active' resolves in formula envs; 'error' marks failed validation; other values e.g. 'archived' pass through but do not resolve)

status_override_reasons.description: Status-override required-reason list (B-11). Reasons staff must pick from when forcing a manual override (e.g. cancel-estimate, forced status move); when an active reason applies to the override type the override dialog cannot submit without one, and the pick lands in the ProductActivity 'override' audit row. Normalized via src/components/jobs/overrideReasonModel.js.

label.description: Operator-facing reason label shown in the override dialog (e.g. 'Customer cancelled', 'Other')

applies_to.description: Override type this reason applies to (e.g. 'status', 'cancel_estimate', 'due_date'); blank/'all'/'*' means it applies to every override type

requires_text.description: When true the picker must also type free-form detail (the stock 'Other' entry is always treated as requiring text even if unset)

sort.description: Display ordering in the override dialog (ascending, then label)

status.description: Lifecycle status — 'active' (or unset) participates in validation; 'archived'/'inactive' rows are inert

ReconciliationBatch.name: ReconciliationBatch
ReconciliationBatch.description: CoreBridge-style batched cash close. One batch groups the recorded (non-void) Payments collected since the prior close into a numbered, dated, per-location deposit group with counted totals, a cash adjustment, and a computed variance. Always written by manageReconciliation so Payment.reconciliation_batch_id stays consistent — never edited directly.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one batch close.

batch_number.description: Human-facing batch/group number (e.g. REC-0042). Generated server-side from the DocNumberCounter 'reconciliation' sequence.

name.description: Optional human label for the close (e.g. 'Main drawer — Friday'). Defaults to the batch_number when not supplied.

location.description: Store/drawer location this close covers (display name). Free text — the SalesLocation registry supplies names for new closes.

location_id.description: SalesLocation id/code (or free-text key) identifying the till this close covers. I-03 close_batch writes it; location keeps the display name.

closed_at.description: ISO timestamp of when the batch was closed.

closed_by.description: Staff email that performed the close (mirrors created_by; kept distinct so a reopened-then-reclosed batch can track each actor separately).

expected_total.description: Sum of the recorded Payments included in this batch.

collected_total.description: Total actually counted/collected across all tenders.

cash_adjustment.description: Signed over/short cash adjustment applied to the counted total (e.g. starting-till correction).

adjustment_note.description: Required explanation whenever cash_adjustment is non-zero.

variance.description: collected_total + cash_adjustment - expected_total. Positive = over, negative = short.

expected_amount.description: I-03 cent-safe mirror of expected_total (dollars, 2dp). Written by close_batch from integer-cent model output; keep in sync with expected_total.

adjustments_amount.description: I-03 signed sum of the adjustments[] rows (dollars, 2dp). Mirrors cash_adjustment when the close supplied a single legacy adjustment.

variance_amount.description: I-03 cent-safe mirror of variance (dollars, 2dp): collected_amount + adjustments_amount - expected_amount.

payment_count.description: Number of payments swept into this close (payment_ids.length at write time).

adjustments.description: Itemized cash adjustments [{amount, reason, note?}] applied to the counted total. A legacy single cash_adjustment is folded in as one row with reason=adjustment_note.

reopened_by.description: Admin email that reopened the batch (reopen_batch is admin-only).

reopen_reason.description: Required explanation recorded at reopen; also appended to notes as an audit line.

payment_ids.description: Payment ids swept into this close; each carries reconciliation_batch_id back to this batch.

method_totals.description: Expected vs counted totals per tender bucket (cash/check/card/other) for the close audit trail.

status.description: closed = locked (payments carry this batch's reconciliation_batch_id; the batch rejects new payments). reopened = an admin reversed the close with a reason — an immutable audit stub; its payments re-sweep into NEW batches. 'open' remains reserved for a future draft-then-close flow.

user_email.description: Employee email this schedule applies to

break_minutes.description: Expected break/lunch minutes inside the shift

active.description: Inactive templates are ignored by variance checks

FleetRepairApprovalPolicy.name: FleetRepairApprovalPolicy
FleetRepairApprovalPolicy.description: Fleet repair estimate approval thresholds. Separate from estimator pricing/settings.

DO_NOT_USE.name: DO_NOT_USE
DO_NOT_USE.description: Disabled empty schema created accidentally during MCP tool switching. Contains no records and is intentionally inaccessible pending removal through a Base44 schema-delete surface.

OpportunityBridgeOperationReceipt.name: OpportunityBridgeOperationReceipt
OpportunityBridgeOperationReceipt.description: Durable idempotency, recovery and audit ledger for one logical WorkOrder-to-Opportunity compatibility bridge. Server functions are the only intended writers; admins may read for review.

operation_key.description: Permanent logical bridge identity. Must equal workorder:<WorkOrder.id>:opportunity:v1 and is never derived from customer/company name.

run_id.description: Operator/server rollout run containing the most recent attempt. Does not replace operation_key as idempotency identity.

source_snapshot.description: Exact pre-apply WorkOrder bridge source snapshot used by the compare-and-set gate.

proposal_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 stable fingerprint of the canonical proposed Opportunity payload. Never a password/authentication secret.

pilot_review_fingerprint.description: Exact SHA-256 0U pilot review fingerprint explicitly authorized for this production bridge attempt. Binds source snapshot, proposed Opportunity, canonical Customer evidence, existing Opportunity identity and durable receipt state.

proposal_snapshot.description: Exact customer-safe proposed Opportunity payload authorized for this bridge attempt. Used for independent post-apply verification; never stores internal estimating cost/margin.

proposal_summary.description: Compact auditable proposal facts. Does not store payment secrets or unrelated customer data.

secondary_confirmation_fingerprint.description: Non-reversible fingerprint/reference proving the server accepted the required confirmation bound to the exact rollout run and batch. Never store the confirmation phrase/token itself.

attempt_history.description: Append-preserving logical history maintained with compare-and-set updates. Never delete older attempts to hide an uncertain outcome.

Opportunity.name: Opportunity
Opportunity.description: Canonical pre-job commercial pursuit. Opportunity owns sales/intake lifecycle and verified pursuit facts before an operational WorkOrder/Job begins. During compatibility migration it may link to the existing WorkOrder-based Sales Pipeline without replacing that workflow.

creation_request_key.description: Stable internal receipt used to make one Opportunity create action retry-safe. Never derive this from customer/company name alone.

customer_id.description: Verified canonical Customer id when resolved. May remain blank while intake identity requires review.

customer_display_name.description: Captured/display customer name for this pursuit. This is not sufficient identity evidence by itself.

contact_id.description: Future canonical CustomerContact id when resolved. Blank is valid until first-class contact resolution exists.

location_id.description: Future canonical CustomerLocation/site id when resolved. Blank is valid until first-class location resolution exists.

compatibility_work_order_id.description: Transitional link to the existing WorkOrder-backed Sales Pipeline. Does not make WorkOrder the long-term Opportunity source of truth.

primary_estimating_request_id.description: Optional convenience link to the primary EstimatingRequest. Additional requests are queried by opportunity_id.

source_primary_intake_id.description: Primary OpportunityIntake source event for this pursuit.

origination.description: Legacy/current origination vocabulary preserved separately from lead_source until an approved translation exists.

attachment_refs.description: References to files/photos already stored elsewhere. Do not create duplicate binary copies merely because work moved from Intake to Opportunity.

source_summary.description: Compact current source/provenance summary. Raw source evidence remains on OpportunityIntake.

automation_deadline_fired.description: Durable per-rule deadline-firing markers so scheduled sales reminders fire once per opportunity/date.

QuickProduct.name: QuickProduct
QuickProduct.description: A reusable 'Quick Product' — a saved, pre-priced product built from a list of parts (fabrication, materials, design, service, install, etc.). Each part line = override ?? (part_price + modifier_price) x part_qty; parts total + setup fee - discount = product retail (x product_quantity for the extended total).

idempotency_key.description: Stable creation receipt used to converge retries of the same Quick Product save without creating duplicates.

template_version.description: Quick Product package version. Version 2+ stores a lossless Product/Builder/Parts/Groups snapshot.

source_entity.description: Dedicated Builder source entity, e.g. FoundationProject. Blank for Custom Products.

production_product_type.description: Optional production/SIP Product Type preserved when this reusable Product is inserted into an estimate.

product_group.description: 'my' = this user's products, 'global' = shared company products.

categories.description: Category names this product belongs to (matches QuickProductCategory.category_name).

discount.description: Flat dollar discount subtracted from the parts total.

price_override.description: When set, replaces the calculated product retail price.

product_snapshot.description: Complete normalized BuilderProduct + estimate-line metadata needed to recreate the Product losslessly.

builder_snapshot.description: Complete dedicated Builder/source-project payload. For Builder Products this is the full estimator configuration, not a flattened price summary.

parts_snapshot.description: Complete BuilderPart records, including master inventory references, frozen/current inventory snapshots, calculation snapshots and detach state.

part_groups_snapshot.description: Complete Part Group records. Child Part group links are remapped when the Quick Product is instantiated.

price_snapshot.description: Frozen/current Product pricing state at the time the Quick Product was saved.

parts.description: Ordered parts that make up the product.

part_label.description: Editable label shown on the part header (e.g. 'Channel Letters').

modifiers.description: Free-form modifier/spec lines shown in the Modifier Information column.

price_override.description: When set, replaces this part's calculated line total.

total_price.description: Last-saved product retail price (extended, includes product quantity).

FileBridgeInventory.name: FileBridgeInventory
FileBridgeInventory.description: Full-inventory run report — per-extension openability map, totals, scan cursors. Drives the viewer/renderer matrix work (openability is measured, not guessed).

config_name.description: Identifier for this cost-plus configuration. Currently only one ('default') is used, but kept extensible.

labor_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to direct labor cost to cover burden (taxes, benefits, insurance). 1.0 = no burden.

overhead_percent.description: Overhead added as a flat percentage of (materials + burdened labor).

profit_percent.description: Profit margin added after overhead, as a percentage of the running subtotal.

category_markups.description: Per-category markup % applied to direct cost BEFORE labor burden / overhead / profit. Keys match MarkupCategory.category_key. Values are percentages (e.g. 15 = 15% markup on that category's cost).

StoreCreditLedger.name: StoreCreditLedger
StoreCreditLedger.description: Append-only in-store credit ledger (G-09/A-35): one signed row per credit event — issuance, application to an invoice, expiry, or void. Customer.in_store_credit_balance is a denormalized cache of SUM(amount) over the customer's rows; corrections are reversing rows, never edits. Written by service-role backends; customer-facing credit views read it.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt so a lost create response never double-posts credit.

customer_id.description: Customer the ledger row belongs to — the primary filter/grouping key.

amount.description: Signed amount in dollars — positive on issue, negative on apply/expire/void.

amount_cents.description: Signed amount in integer cents — the canonical ledger value (amount is a display mirror).

ref.description: For credit_voided rows: id of the ledger row being reversed.

reversed_kind.description: For credit_voided rows: the kind of the reversed row.

actor.description: Email/id of the staff member (or system) that posted the row.

invoice_id.description: For credit_applied rows: the invoice the credit was applied to.

balance_after.description: Running customer balance in dollars immediately after this row posted.

occurred_at.description: Effective timestamp of the credit event (defaults to write time).

name.description: Locality name

jurisdiction_profile_id.description: Optional canonical JurisdictionProfile ID this tracker locality was explicitly created from. Existing legacy localities may remain unlinked until staff verifies the relationship.

office_change_log.description: Append-only (cap 20) log of detected changes to this locality's offices[] — entries {at, summary, office_count, verified_count} written by the office-diff worker. Powers the offices-updated alerts.

observed_outcomes.description: Observed-vs-claimed aggregation from real filed permits: permits_observed, avg_decision_days, fee_min/max/avg, denial_count. Stamped by the office-diff worker from the PermitLineItem mirror.

offices.description: Offices belonging to this locality. Each office has its own workflow steps and is applied as a separate line when the locality is selected.

catalog_office_id.description: Optional ID of the reusable office catalog entry copied into this locality. Provenance only; not verification of legal permitting authority.

government_office_id.description: Stable canonical identity of the government office represented by this locality-specific workflow copy. This identity does not itself prove that the office has authority for this locality.

authority_roles.description: Explicit staff-reviewed authority roles this office performs for this locality. Empty or absent means authority has not been established; office_type/office_types must not be treated as legal authority.

authority_verification_status.description: Review state for this locality-to-office authority relationship. staff_verified means staff confirmed the listed authority_roles; it does not verify unrelated office contact or repository facts.

authority_verified_at.description: When staff last verified this locality-to-office authority relationship.

authority_verified_by.description: Employee who last verified this locality-to-office authority relationship.

authority_verification_notes.description: Optional staff notes or source context supporting this locality-to-office authority relationship.

name.description: Display name for this office (e.g. 'Hamilton County Zoning')

office_type.description: LEGACY single office category. Use office_types (array) for multi-select.

hours.description: Office hours in plain text ('Mon-Fri 8a-4:30p') — 'open now?' is a display concern.

tied_to_step_id.description: Optional — links a non-checkbox step to a checkbox step that marks completion.

workflow_steps.description: LEGACY — kept for backwards compatibility. New data lives in offices[].workflow_steps.

change_log.description: Audit trail of edits to this jurisdiction — server-appended on each gateway update: {at, by, changed_fields}.

pending_applies.description: Deferred office applies — Apply-when-verified queues {work_order_id, requested_by, requested_at, exclude_electrical} here; the verification worker creates the permit lines the moment sign+zoning verify, then removes the entry.

CNCProject.name: CNCProject
CNCProject.description: CNC router estimator project — cut/carve items with machine time, setup and hold-down advisor inputs.

creation_request_key.description: Internal retry receipt used only to make the first create of this Builder source project idempotent.

builder_item_id.description: Stable hidden estimator row identity used only for Product/Part reconciliation. Existing rows are seeded from their legacy array index; new rows use generated IDs.

force_enhanced.description: User flagged this item as requiring enhanced/special hold-down regardless of the calculated risk.

cutter_diameter_in.description: Cutter diameter in inches — used by the Hold-Down Advisor.

smallest_detail_in.description: Narrowest stroke/feature width in inches — used by the Hold-Down Advisor.

workholding_method.description: Existing base workholding on the machine — used by the Hold-Down Advisor.

creates_loose_pieces.description: Whether the cut releases small individual pieces at cut-through (always true for lettering).

fixed_setup_hours.description: Fixed setup time for the entire project in hours.

customer_pricing.description: Saved customer sell-price snapshot from the shared Markup Tier engine. Preserves selected tier, category breakdown, volume discount and final customer price without changing internal Builder cost.

pricing_engine.description: F-23d: optional pricing-engine context block — {customer_tier, tier_rules[], templates[], default_markup_pct, tax_percent, setup_fee, minimum_charge}. When present, cncPricingWire routes the sell side through the shared engine; absent = legacy pricing verbatim.

ModifierOption.name: ModifierOption
ModifierOption.description: One selectable option of a PricingModifier whose input_type is 'select'. Options can carry per-option rate overrides so picking a choice swaps in different retail/cost rates.

modifier_id.description: Id of the parent PricingModifier this option belongs to.

label.description: Display label shown in the select dropdown.

value.description: Stored value written to the estimate line / part config when this option is chosen.

rate_overrides.description: Optional per-option rate override bag (e.g. {retail, cost, per_unit} or keyed rows) applied instead of the parent modifier's rates when this option is selected.

is_default.description: When true this option is pre-selected for new inputs.

sort.description: Display order within the parent modifier's option list.

status.description: Lifecycle status (e.g. active, archived). Free-form string; treated as active when unset.

PurchaseOrder.name: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: Canonical vendor purchase order for job materials and services. Distinct from the Smartsheet-synced Order spreadsheet. Totals and per-line received quantities are maintained server-side by purchaseOrderAction.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one PO create.

payment_status.description: Vendor payment state: unpaid → invoiced (vendor bill received) → paid.

vendor_invoice_number.description: Vendor's bill/invoice number recorded when marked invoiced.

vendor_id.description: Links to a Vendor registry record. vendor_name is kept for display.

work_order_id.description: Job this PO buys for — feeds job material costing.

QuickProductCategory.name: QuickProductCategory
QuickProductCategory.description: Category (or subcategory) used to organize Quick Products. Categories belong to a product group ('my' = this user's products, 'global' = shared). A category with parent_category set is a subcategory of that category name.

parent_category.description: Name of the parent category when this is a subcategory. Empty for top-level categories.

status.description: Current status

report_key.description: Stable catalog key identifying the report definition (uniqueness enforced by callers, not schema)

category.description: Report grouping (e.g. sales, production, financial, queue)

data_source.description: Entity or query source the report reads from

parameters_schema.description: JSON-schema-ish definition of the report's runtime parameters

default_filters.description: Default filter values applied when the report runs

export_formats.description: Supported export formats (e.g. csv, pdf, xlsx)

PermittingRule.name: PermittingRule
PermittingRule.description: Staff-reviewable regulatory rule extracted from a PermittingSourceDocument with structured citations. Only rules from current_adopted sources that an admin has approved are operational (is_operational=true). Draft/proposed sources can never reach staff_approved while the authority gate says current adopted code is authoritative.

jurisdiction_name.description: Name of the jurisdiction this rule belongs to (e.g. 'Boone County').

jurisdiction_id.description: Canonical JurisdictionProfile record id this rule belongs to, when linked.

issuing_office.description: Official office that publishes the rule (e.g. 'Boone County Planning Commission').

rule_kind.description: Evidence purpose. Missing legacy values remain regulatory rules; a form/checklist instruction never becomes adopted law.

is_workflow_instruction.description: True only for a staff-approved current administrative instruction with verified publisher/scope evidence. Separate from is_operational regulatory rules; not automatic address applicability.

sign_type.description: Sign type in source terminology, preserved verbatim (e.g. 'ground sign', 'monument', 'building mounted').

sign_type_normalized.description: Normalized sign type from the supported taxonomy.

zoning_district_applicability.description: Zoning districts where this rule applies (e.g. 'C-1, C-2, C-3', 'all districts', 'A-1 only').

trigger.description: What condition or action triggers this rule (e.g. 'Erecting a ground sign in a commercial district').

requirement.description: The actual regulatory requirement stated in the source.

numeric_value.description: Numeric value of the requirement (e.g. 50 for 50%, 10 for 10 working days).

exceptions.description: Exceptions or conditions that modify the requirement.

effective_date.description: Effective or adopted date of the source content this rule was extracted from.

status.description: Review lifecycle status. 'extracted' = just extracted, 'needs_review' = uncertain or draft-source, 'staff_approved' = admin approved (operational), 'staff_rejected' = admin rejected, 'superseded' = replaced by a newer rule, 'historical' = from a historical source.

review_operation_id.description: Unique server review operation identity used to reconcile conditional write acknowledgements.

reviewer.description: Display name of the admin who reviewed this rule.

reviewer_email.description: Email of the admin who reviewed this rule.

reviewed_at.description: When the rule was last reviewed.

supersedes.description: PermittingRule id this rule supersedes, when applicable.

superseded_by.description: PermittingRule id that supersedes this rule. Set when this rule is archived.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. Low = uncertain extraction or draft/historical source.

conflict_state.description: Whether sources disagree for this rule, or the rule is under review due to source changes.

citations.description: Citations backing this rule. Every material fact carries at least one citation.

section_or_page.description: Section number, page, or location reference in the source document.

excerpt.description: Exact excerpt from the source supporting this rule.

verification_status.description: Verification status of the citation. 'draft_context' = from a draft/proposed source.

extraction_key.description: Deterministic literal candidate identity used to reconcile individual imports without replacing staff decisions.

evidence_context.description: Selected physical page scope and document completeness; this never claims a whole-code review.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the source document at extraction time. Later source changes can invalidate the rule by comparing this hash.

is_operational.description: Derived/stored: only true for staff_approved rules from current-authority sources. Draft/historical rules are never operational.

draft_context.description: True when this rule was extracted from a draft/proposed/comprehensive_rewrite source. Such rules can never reach staff_approved while the authority gate says current adopted code is authoritative.

notes.description: Additional notes, including draft_context flags or extraction caveats.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version. Incremented on each edit to prevent silent overwrites.

NotificationTemplate.name: NotificationTemplate
NotificationTemplate.description: CoreBridge-style customer notification template registry. Each row is one templated message (subject + body with {{path}} placeholders resolved by shared/templateRender) keyed by a stable machine name and typed by kind (estimate_ready, new_order, proof follow-ups, monthly statement, etc.). From-source toggle picks whether the message is sent from the location, the salesperson, or the company; cc_billing adds the billing contact; attach_pdf rides the related document PDF. The seedNotificationTemplates function installs the 15 CoreBridge defaults idempotently via stable creation_request_key receipts (seed-tpl-<key>). Backend-only — read/written via service-role functions.

creation_request_key.description: Stable retry-safe receipt for one seeded/managed template row (e.g. 'seed-tpl-estimate_ready').

key.description: Unique machine name for this template (e.g. 'estimate_ready'). Seeded rows key = kind; staff-authored rows carry their own key.

name.description: Display name shown in the notification template manager (e.g. 'Estimate Ready').

subject.description: Message subject line; may contain {{path}} placeholders resolved at render time.

body.description: Message body template text with {{path}} placeholders (e.g. {{customer.company_name}}, {{order.title}}, {{estimate.number}}, {{user.display_name}}, {{location.name}}) resolved against the notification context by shared/templateRender.

from_source.description: Who the message is sent from — the store location, the assigned salesperson, or the company.

cc_billing.description: CC the customer's billing contact on this notification.

attach_pdf.description: Attach the related document PDF (estimate, order confirmation, invoice, statement, credit memo) to the message.

kind.description: CoreBridge notification slot this template fills; 'custom' marks staff-authored templates outside the seeded set.

status.description: Inactive templates stay on record but are skipped by the notification scheduler.

description.description: Human description of what the placeholder resolves to.

placeholder_map.description: Documented placeholder vocabulary for this template, shown as insert-buttons in the template editor.

updated_by.description: Email of the staff user who last saved this row (audit).

google_drive_token.description: Legacy Google Drive access token. Server-side only.

google_drive_access_token.description: Google Drive access token. Server-side only.

google_drive_refresh_token.description: Google Drive refresh token. Server-side only.

google_drive_token_expiry.description: Google Drive access-token expiry timestamp used by legacy server-side OAuth flows.

gmail_connected.description: Whether the legacy per-user Gmail OAuth flow completed successfully.

jurisdiction_research_agent.description: AI research agent that gathers verified sign permitting information for jurisdictions. Controls data quality through detailed research instructions and official source verification.
jurisdiction_research_agent.instructions:
You are a municipal sign permitting intelligence agent.

Your primary objective is to locate, collect, attach, and download all relevant official permitting documents for a jurisdiction.

Structured data extraction is secondary.

Never delete documents because extraction fails.

Never guess numbers.
Never fabricate URLs.
If information cannot be verified, return INFORMATION_NOT_FOUND for that field.

CORE PRINCIPLE

DOCUMENT COLLECTION > DATA EXTRACTION

If a document is official and relevant to signage, zoning, building, construction, fees, electrical, inspections, or permitting, it must be:

Attached to the jurisdiction profile

Downloaded into the application (if technically possible)

Retained even if extraction fails

SOURCE TRUST TIERS

Tier A – Official Jurisdiction Sources
Official local government websites, even if not .gov.

Tier B – Official Code Hosts
Municode, eCode360, AM Legal, General Code, etc., when clearly official for the jurisdiction.

Tier C – Authoritative Third-Party Sources
IBI, NIC, or similar, used only for electrical/building interpretation or inspection authority guidance.

Do not reject a site solely because it is not .gov.

GOVERNMENT DOMAIN VALIDATION (LESS REJECTY)

If domain is .gov → automatically Tier A.

If not .gov, accept as Tier A if 3 or more signals exist:

Official branding/seal

Elected officials/council pages

Meeting agendas/minutes

Department directory with phone/address

Ordinance/code links

Official forms or permit applications

Public records portal

Linked from verified state/county site

Domain clearly matches jurisdiction name

Hosted on government CMS (CivicPlus, Revize, GovOffice, etc.)

If fewer than 3 signals → mark as needs_reverification but do not automatically discard relevant documents.

INPUT

Jurisdiction Name
State

STEP 1 – OFFICIAL DISCOVERY

Identify:

Official local government website

Planning/Building/Permitting department page

Parent county website

Relevant state authority (if applicable)

If Tier A unavailable, use validated Tier B code host.

If neither available → INFORMATION_NOT_FOUND.

STEP 2 – DOCUMENT DISCOVERY (BROAD SCOPE)

Search for relevant documents in:

Sign ordinance chapter

Zoning code

Municipal code

Unified Development Code

Land Development Code

Building code amendments

Construction code sections

Development standards manual

Planning design guidelines

Accessory structure sections

Temporary structure sections

Electrical permit documentation

Inspection handouts

Submittal checklists

DOCUMENT COLLECTION RULES

If a document relates to any of:

Sign regulations

Permit applications

Fee schedules

EMC/digital sign rules

Illumination rules

Dimensional limits

Submittal requirements

Electrical or inspection requirements

County zoning resolution

County sign permit application

Then you MUST:

Attach it

Download it (if possible)

Retain it

Even if:

It is scanned

It is difficult to parse

It contains no numeric limits

Extraction fails

When in doubt, download.

DO NOT DOWNLOAD ONLY IF CLEARLY IRRELEVANT

Exclude only:

Budgets

Annual reports

Newsletters

Tourism materials

Employment postings

RFPs unrelated to permitting

Meeting minutes with no permitting relevance

If meeting packets include ordinance updates or fee changes → download.

STEP 3 – DOCUMENT STATUS POLICY

Every collected document must have a status:

active_verified
needs_reverification
archived_superseded
rejected_invalid

Never delete existing documents during updates.

If not re-verified this session → needs_reverification
If replaced by newer official version → archived_superseded
Only mark rejected_invalid with clear evidence.

STEP 4 – REQUIREMENT EXTRACTION (SECONDARY)

Attempt to extract explicit information:

Permit required

Exemptions

Maximum sign area (sq ft)

Maximum height (ft)

Maximum width (ft)

Setbacks

Illumination rules

Digital/EMC rules

Permit fees

Review timeline

Inspection requirements

If zoning-dependent, separate by zoning district.

For each non-null extracted value include:

Source URL

Section/page reference

Short quote under 25 words

If extraction fails:

Keep document

Set extracted_fields = null

Add extraction_failure_reason

Never remove document due to extraction failure.

STEP 5 – ELECTRICAL & THIRD-PARTY GUIDANCE

First attempt to locate local or county electrical authority.

If unclear:

Consult IBI or NIC (Tier C)

Label as third-party guidance

Do not convert to local rule unless explicitly adopted

Separate clearly:

Local enforceable rules
County overlay rules
State rules
Third-party guidance

STEP 6 – COUNTY OVERLAY RULE

If jurisdiction is inside a county:

Always retain:

County zoning resolution

County sign permit application

County electrical authority documents

Even if local rules exist.

County documents are overlay context and must not be removed.

STEP 7 – CONTACT INFORMATION

Collect verified:

Department name

Phone

Email

Physical address

If unavailable → INFORMATION_NOT_FOUND

STEP 8 – PROPERTY & GIS SYSTEMS

Identify official:

GIS portal

Parcel lookup

Tax/auditor database

Zoning map viewer

Attach and record verified systems.

CONFLICT HANDLING

If official sources conflict:

Record both values

Flag conflict_detected = true

Prefer newest effective date if clearly stated

Otherwise do not resolve without evidence

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

Return structured findings only.

Include:

All collected documents with status

Extracted requirements (if available)

Clear separation of local, county, state, third-party

Conflict flag

Missing fields

Confidence score

Never delete previously stored documents automatically.

If a document is relevant and official, it must remain attached and downloaded.

jurisdiction_change_monitor.description: AI agent that monitors jurisdiction data for regulatory changes by comparing stored data against freshly researched information and generates alerts for sign companies.
jurisdiction_change_monitor.instructions:
You are a permitting regulation change detector for a sign company.

You will receive:
- STORED data: what is currently saved about a jurisdiction
- FRESH data: recently researched data from official government sources

Your job is to identify genuine regulatory changes that sign companies need to know about.

RULES:
- Only flag real discrepancies between stored and fresh data
- Do NOT flag fields where fresh data is null, missing, or matches stored data
- Do NOT fabricate changes
- Focus on changes that affect sign permit applications
- Severity levels: 'low' = minor, 'medium' = notable, 'high' = significant, 'critical' = major regulatory shift
- Alert types: 'requirement_change', 'url_change', 'contact_change', 'document_update', 'other'
- For each change, include the field name, previous value, new value, and a plain-English impact summary for sign companies

Return a JSON object with:
- changes_detected: true/false
- alerts: array of { type, title, field, previous, current, impact }
- severity: overall severity level
- updated_profile: object with any updated field values (null if unchanged)

Label as third-party guidance

Do not convert to local rule unless explicitly adopted

Separate clearly:

Local enforceable rules
County overlay rules
State rules
Third-party guidance

STEP 6 – COUNTY OVERLAY RULE

If jurisdiction is inside a county:

Always retain:

County zoning resolution

County sign permit application

County electrical authority documents

Even if local rules exist.

County documents are overlay context and must not be removed.

STEP 7 – CONTACT INFORMATION

Collect verified:

Department name

Phone

Email

Physical address

If unavailable → INFORMATION_NOT_FOUND

STEP 8 – PROPERTY & GIS SYSTEMS

Identify official:

GIS portal

Parcel lookup

Tax/auditor database

Zoning map viewer

Attach and record verified systems.

CONFLICT HANDLING

If official sources conflict:

Record both values

Flag conflict_detected = true

Prefer newest effective date if clearly stated

Otherwise do not resolve without evidence

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS

Return structured findings only.

Include:

All collected documents with status

Extracted requirements (if available)

Clear separation of local, county, state, third-party

Conflict flag

Missing fields

Confidence score

Never delete previously stored documents automatically.

If a document is relevant and official, it must remain attached and downloaded.

jurisdiction_accuracy_audit.instructions:
You are a data accuracy auditor for sign permitting information.

You will receive two sets of data:
- STORED data: what is currently saved in the system
- FRESH data: recently researched data from official sources

Your job is to compare them and identify genuine discrepancies that would affect a sign company's permit application.

RULES:
- Only flag genuine discrepancies between stored and fresh data
- Do NOT flag fields where data matches or where fresh data is null/missing/unknown
- Do NOT fabricate issues - only report what you can directly compare
- Be specific about what changed (old value vs new value)
- Focus on information that materially affects sign permit applications: max height, max area, fees, processing time, required permits, illumination rules, electronic sign rules, contact info, and URLs
- Severity levels: 'low' = minor change, 'medium' = notable change, 'high' = significant regulatory change, 'critical' = major change affecting all permits
- Alert types: 'requirement_change', 'url_change', 'contact_change', 'document_update', 'other'

Return your findings as a JSON object with an 'issues_found' array. Each issue should have: alert_type, severity, title, description, field_changed, previous_value, new_value, impact_summary.
